abstract: [The Journal of urology] Since 1986, the Mayo Clinic Prostate Cancer Registry has followed over 30,000 patients who underwent radical prostatectomy. Advances in LLMs may modernize data collection, reduce human abstraction burden, and improve registry efficiency. Herein, we report the results of LLM data abstraction for surgical pathology and prostate MRI data in the Mayo Clinic Prostate Cancer Registry. Surgical pathology and MRI reports were obtained for 3,210 and 4,739 patients, respectively, who underwent radical prostatectomy from 2010-2022. LLM prompts for 13 pathology and 20 MRI variables were developed and ran through two independent LLMs (Google Gemini Flash 1.5, 2.0, or 2.5). LLM outputs were compared to human-abstracted data. Median consensus LLM error rate for pathology report data was 0.09%(IQR 0.03-0.16%), compared with median human error rate of 2.81%(IQR 1.83-3.17%). Individual LLMs had threefold higher error rates compared to consensus LLM (LLM 1: 0.27%(IQR 0.09-0.34%), LLM 2: 0.30%(IQR 0.17%-0.48%)). For MRI reports, median consensus LLM error rate was 0.17%(IQR 0.00-0.68%), compared with human error rate of 1.01%(IQR 0.59-3.20%). Individual LLMs had error rates of 0.84%(IQR 0.34-2.79%) and 1.02%(IQR 0.34-1.67%). Estimated time for human data abstraction across all 136,510 data elements was 952 hours, compared with 32 hours for our LLM pipeline. LLM data abstraction employing a consensus vote across two independent LLMs consistently yielded higher accuracy than human or single-LLM abstraction. A dual-LLM consensus architecture may improve data abstraction efficiency, reduce errors, and should be considered for integration into all prospectively maintained longitudinal clinical registries.

abstract: [Asian cardiovascular & thoracic annals] BackgroundElectrocardiography (ECG) is inexpensive and widely available, yet its ability to detect early and nonobstructive coronary artery disease (CAD) is limited when interpreted using conventional criteria. We evaluated whether a deep learning model applied to standard 12-lead-ECG images can identify angiographically confirmed CAD and enable clinically meaningful risk stratification in a real-world population.MethodsIn this multicentric study, 15,890 ECG-angiography pairs (12-lead ECG paired with coronary angiography [CA] or coronary CT angiography [CCTA]) were included between November 2021 and January 2024. A DenseNet-121 convolutional neural network was trained to predict CAD from ECG images. Temporal validation was performed on a prospectively collected, independent cohort of 2168 samples from February to May 2024. Model performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC), PR-AUC, and standard diagnostic metrics. Robustness across varying disease prevalence was evaluated using simulation, and prevalence-dependent predictive performance was summarized using PPV and NPV prevalence curves (AUCppv and AUCnpv).ResultsThe model was trained on 13,299 samples, validated on 1,002, and tested on 1339 (CAD prevalence 52.9%). On the test set, ROC-AUC was 0.80 and PR-AUC 0.83. At the optimal 0.50 threshold, sensitivity was 87% (618/708 CAD cases detected) and specificity 50% (317/631 non-CAD correctly classified). On the temporal validation set (n = 2168; 64% CAD), ROC-AUC was 0.81 and PR-AUC 0.83, with sensitivity 0.67, specificity 0.78, PPV 0.84, and NPV 0.57. Simulated prevalence analyses demonstrated robust PPV/NPV trends across distributions.ConclusionDeep learning analysis of routinely acquired ECG images can identify patients at increased risk of CAD and may support low-cost, scalable CAD risk stratification.

【背景】心电图（ECG）价格低廉且应用广泛，但按常规标准解读时，其检出早期和非阻塞性冠状动脉疾病（CAD）的能力有限。我们评估了应用于标准 12 导联心电图图像的深度学习模型能否识别经血管造影证实的 CAD，并在真实世界人群中实现具有临床意义的风险分层。

【结果】模型在 13,299 例样本上训练，在 1,002 例上验证，在 1339 例上测试（CAD 患病率 52.9%）。在测试集上，ROC-AUC 为 0.80，PR-AUC 为 0.83。在最佳阈值 0.50 时，敏感度为 87%（检出 708 例 CAD 中的 618 例），特异度为 50%（正确分类 631 例非 CAD 中的 317 例）。在时间验证集（n = 2168；CAD 占 64%）上，ROC-AUC 为 0.81，PR-AUC 为 0.83，敏感度 0.67，特异度 0.78，PPV 0.84，NPV 0.57。模拟患病率分析显示，PPV/NPV 趋势在不同分布下均稳健。
【结论】对常规采集的心电图图像进行深度学习分析可识别 CAD 风险增高的患者，并可能支持低成本、可扩展的 CAD 风险分层。

abstract: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.

abstract: Protein engineering requires navigating rugged fitness landscapes, where small sequence changes can produce large functional differences, but experimental screening can only sample a small fraction of sequence space. Thus, a central challenge is to efficiently traverse the large combinatorial space of mutations in silico. We introduce ProTEUS, a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution. Pretrained on deep mutational scanning assays, ProTEUS learns a joint representation of sequence, evolutionary, and structural information using MutationFormer, a mutation-biased attention architecture. Variants are represented as states in this joint latent space, and mutations define actions whose functional consequences are predicted. To support exploration of many mutants, we developed a fast, physics-constrained all-atom predictor that utilizes explicit geometric constraint enforcement to achieve >10 fold increase in speed than AlphaFold3 with guaranteed physical validity. Lastly, ProTEUS refines its prediction and understanding of protein activity through closed loop experimental feedback to guide evolution toward a desired phenotype. ProTEUS surpasses established models in both zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning mutation prediction tasks. We experimentally demonstrate its utility in two closed-loop multi-objective engineering campaigns on aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase, yielding variants with >10 fold higher activity than wild type. ProTEUS provides a world-model framework that connects virtual evaluation of mutational outcomes with experimental learning for efficient protein evolution.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质工程需要在崎岖的适应度景观中探索，其中微小的序列变化可能导致巨大的功能差异，而实验筛选只能覆盖序列空间的一小部分。因此，一个核心挑战是在计算机上高效遍历庞大的突变组合空间。我们提出了 ProTEUS，一种用于闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型。ProTEUS 在深度突变扫描实验数据上预训练，利用 MutationFormer（一种突变偏置注意力架构）学习序列、进化和结构信息的联合表征。变体被表示为该联合潜空间中的状态，突变则定义为动作，并预测其功能后果。为了支持对大量突变体的探索，我们开发了一种快速的、受物理约束的全原子预测器，该预测器采用显式几何约束强制执行，速度比 AlphaFold3 提高 >10 倍，并保证物理有效性。最后，ProTEUS 通过闭环实验反馈不断完善其对蛋白质活性的预测和理解，从而引导进化朝向期望的表型。ProTEUS 在零样本和有监督微调的突变预测任务中均超越了现有模型。我们通过醛脱氢酶和果聚糖蔗糖酶（levansucrase）两项闭环多目标工程实验证明了其实用性，获得了活性比野生型高 >10 倍的变体。ProTEUS 提供了一个世界模型框架，将突变结果的虚拟评估与实验学习相连接，以实现高效的蛋白质进化。

abstract: [Viral immunology] The discovery of therapeutic antibodies is a traditionally arduous process. Today, the lab-based process of antibody discovery consists of several time-consuming steps that involve live animal immunization, B-cell harvesting, hybridoma creation, and then downstream engineering and evaluation. However, the use of artificial intelligence in drug design has previously been shown effective in the rapid generation of protein-specific binders, small molecules, and even antibody therapeutics, thereby replacing some of the primary steps of the drug discovery process. Here, we present peleke-1, a suite of protein language models fine-tuned from state-of-the-art large language models using curated antibody-antigen complex data. These models generate targeted antibody Fv sequences for a given antigen sequence input at-scale. This suite of models provides a reliable, artificial intelligence-driven approach for in silico therapeutic antibody discovery along with an open-source framework for future antibody language model tuning.

abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly positioned to improve heart failure (HF) care by predicting risk, enabling earlier disease identification, and supporting more reliable delivery of evidence-based management. Current applications span opportunistic detection for low ejection fraction, HF with preserved ejection fraction, and structural heart disease using tools such as AI-enabled electrocardiography, imaging- and electronic health record‒based risk stratification, clinician-facing decision support, remote medication titration, and wearable monitoring platforms. The strongest evidence suggests that AI is most effective when embedded into active clinical workflows that guide targeted testing, treatment optimization, and longitudinal follow-up, rather than functioning as passive alerts alone. This review examines the emerging landscape of AI-enabled HF care delivery from early detection through chronic management, with emphasis on implementation, workflow integration, and the capacity of these tools to improve diagnostic yield and ultimately scalability.

abstract: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. These agents achieve up to 67% and 74% accuracy, respectively, exceeding observed expert performance. LLM-guided feature discovery generally outperforms direct reasoning, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves open-weight models, enabling them to match or surpass closed-source frontier models in our evaluations. These results establish Pyrite as a challenging test of pose-ranking ability and highlight LLM-guided feature discovery as a promising approach to interpret and combine the outputs of computational chemistry tools.
zh_abstract: 预测配体如何与其靶标结合是小分子药物发现的核心。现代共折叠（cofolding）模型可以生成多样的候选结合构象，但对这些候选构象进行可靠排序仍具挑战。我们提出了 Pyrite，一个成对构象排序基准，包含涵盖多种蛋白-配体复合物的 1,500 个构象对。配备三维可视化工具和基于物理的评分的专家化学家的表现接近随机水平，凸显了解读现有化学信号的难度。为研究自动化排序，我们提出了 PyriteRep，一种对分子几何、蛋白-配体相互作用和物理化学评分的结构化表示，并开发了两种基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体：PyriteReasoner，通过基于文本的推理直接比较构象；以及 PyriteFeaturizer，生成可执行代码以构建用于逻辑回归的特征，并可选择性地纳入由 LLM 子调用得到的特征。这两种智能体的准确率分别最高可达 67% 和 74%，超过观察到的专家表现。LLM 引导的特征发现总体上优于直接推理，而组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization，GRPO）可提升开放权重模型，使其在我们的评估中达到或超过闭源前沿模型。这些结果确立了 Pyrite 作为构象排序能力的一项具有挑战性的测试，并凸显了 LLM 引导的特征发现作为解释和整合计算化学工具输出的一种有前景的方法。

title: Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
zh_title: 医学图像分割：基础模型适配与任务专用训练对比
summary: 比较DINOv2不同适配策略与从头训练的U-Net，在结肠镜、乳腺超声、皮肤镜上做跨机构外部数据测试。
key_points: 适配策略从仅调偏置到全量微调
覆盖结肠镜、乳腺超声、皮肤镜
含训练来源与其他机构独立数据测试
reason: 基础模型适配的外部验证对比较充分，但为预印本，有方向加分
abstract: Foundation models pretrained on large natural-image collections are increasingly adapted for medical image segmentation, in the expectation that they will replace models trained for each task. Most comparisons, however, use data from the training distribution and a single task-specific baseline whose configuration is rarely justified, and therefore provide limited evidence of performance at new clinical sites. It also remains unclear how much of a foundation model must be adapted, and what determines this. We adapted a foundation model, DINOv2, with strategies ranging from tuning only its bias terms to full fine-tuning, and compared it with U-Nets and ResU-Nets trained from scratch. Experiments covered colonoscopy, breast ultrasound and dermoscopy, with testing on held-out data from the training source and on independent datasets from other institutions. The adapted foundation model generalised better on every external dataset. Within the training distribution, the task-specific models remained competitive when training data were abundant, and delineated boundaries more precisely, while the foundation model more often missed small lesions. Only a small fraction of the foundation model required adaptation, and the capacity needed was determined by the imaging domain rather than by the adaptation method. A widely used polyp test set was also found to duplicate images from another benchmark. Foundation-model adaptation is therefore warranted where models must work across sites, with capacity selected on the target domain.
zh_abstract: 在大型自然图像集上预训练的基础模型越来越多地被用于医学图像分割，人们期望其取代针对各任务训练的模型。然而，大多数比较使用的是训练分布内的数据和单一的任务特异性基线（其配置很少有依据），因此对新临床站点上性能的证据有限。此外，基础模型需要适配多少、由什么决定，目前仍不清楚。我们采用从仅调整偏置项到完全微调的多种策略适配基础模型 DINOv2，并将其与从头训练的 U-Net 和 ResU-Net 进行比较。实验涵盖结肠镜检查、乳腺超声和皮肤镜检查，并在来自训练来源的留出数据以及来自其他机构的独立数据集上进行测试。适配后的基础模型在每个外部数据集上均具有更好的泛化能力。在训练分布内，当训练数据充足时，任务特异性模型仍具竞争力，且对边界的勾画更精确，而基础模型更常漏检小病灶。基础模型只有一小部分需要适配，所需容量由成像领域而非适配方法决定。我们还发现一个广泛使用的息肉测试集与另一基准存在重复图像。因此，在模型必须跨站点工作的情况下，基础模型适配是合理的，且应根据目标领域选择容量。

title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
zh_title: Hx2Dx：面向对话式临床推理的多模态评测场
summary: 提出基于1000例NEJM病例的交互式基准，模拟问诊、查体到诊断的迭代过程，评估LLM临床推理。
key_points: 静态病例评测忽略问诊过程
1000例NEJM病例构成模拟接诊
覆盖病史采集、体格检查到诊断
reason: 有新意的交互式基准，预印本，摘要结果有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve expert-level diagnostic accuracy in static evaluations, where the model receives a curated vignette or case report that already condenses the diagnostically relevant findings. Such evaluations measure inference over already selected evidence; the evaluations do not account for the inquiry used to obtain it. In clinical practice, however, diagnosis is an iterative process of inquiry. Clinicians take the patient's history, or anamnesis (Hx), through targeted questioning, examine the patient, and request and interpret tests, progressively narrowing the differential until they reach a final diagnosis (Dx). We introduce Hx2Dx ARENA, an interactive benchmark of 1'000 clinical cases from the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM). Each case is a simulated encounter that proceeds from initial presentation through history taking and physical examination to diagnostic workup. We evaluate open- and closed-source LLMs under multiple configurations. Performance varies considerably across models in the interactive setting, and every model loses diagnostic accuracy relative to the static setting, where the full case is presented upfront. The ability to ask the right questions accounts for much of both the gap between models and the loss of accuracy: diagnosis improves as questions become more targeted and build a more complete clinical picture. LLMs thus reason well once the relevant data are available but remain limited in hypothesis-driven information gathering, in knowing what to ask in order to know. Closing this gap is a prerequisite for their safe integration into real-world diagnostic workflows.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在静态评估中可达到专家水平的诊断准确率，在这类评估中模型接收的是已精心整理、浓缩了诊断相关发现的病例摘要或病例报告。此类评估衡量的是对已筛选证据的推断；评估并未考虑获取这些证据所用的问诊过程。然而在临床实践中，诊断是一个反复探究的过程。临床医生通过有针对性的提问采集患者病史（anamnesis，Hx），对患者进行检查，申请并解读检验，逐步缩小鉴别诊断范围，直至得出最终诊断（Dx）。我们提出了 Hx2Dx ARENA，一个由来自《新英格兰医学杂志》（NEJM）的 1,000 个临床病例组成的交互式基准。每个病例都是一次模拟就诊，从初始表现开始，经过病史采集和体格检查，直至诊断性检查。我们在多种配置下评估了开源和闭源 LLM。在交互式设置中，各模型的表现差异很大，且与一开始就呈现完整病例的静态设置相比，每个模型的诊断准确率都有所下降。提出恰当问题的能力在很大程度上解释了模型之间的差距以及准确率的下降：随着提问更具针对性并构建出更完整的临床图景，诊断结果会得到改善。因此，一旦相关数据可得，LLM 能够很好地推理，但在以假设为导向的信息收集方面——即知道该问什么才能获知所需信息——仍然存在局限。弥合这一差距是将其安全整合入真实世界诊断工作流程的前提。

title: The BRIDGE dataset: paired brightfield whole-slide images of prostate core-needle biopsies in paraffin, after deparaffinization and H&E staining
zh_title: BRIDGE：前列腺穿刺活检配对明场全切片数据集
summary: 发布来自波兰肿瘤中心的前列腺穿刺活检数据集，含169例患者869张玻片、2607张配对WSI，用于无标记虚拟染色研究。
key_points: 同一玻片在石蜡、脱蜡、H&E染色后依次数字化
共869张玻片、2607张全切片图像
支持虚拟染色模型开发与外部验证
reason: 新发布的配对病理数据集，规模中等，预印本；病理方向加分
abstract: Computational approaches are increasingly being explored to streamline histopathology workflows, including label-free methods that aim to reduce reliance on chemical staining. Among these, deep learning-based label-free virtual staining uses images of unstained tissue to computationally generate stained images. Despite growing interest, model development and validation remain constrained by the scarcity of paired, clinically annotated whole-slide imaging datasets. We present BRIDGE, a dataset of prostate core-needle biopsies collected at the Prof. Franciszek Lukaszczyk Oncology Centre in Bydgoszcz, Poland. The dataset comprises 869 glass slides from 169 patients, each digitized sequentially after sectioning, deparaffinization, and hematoxylin and eosin staining, yielding in total 2607 whole-slide images. The dataset supports the development and external validation of label-free virtual staining, virtual unstaining, image-registration and segmentation methods. Each slide is accompanied by a Gleason score, enabling downstream analyses of cancer classification and grading concordance. The stained images can be used independently for color normalization and cross-scanner robustness studies. All images are de-identified, distributed in their native scanner format and will be available through the BioImage Archive.
zh_abstract: 计算方法正越来越多地被用于简化组织病理学工作流程，其中包括旨在减少对化学染色依赖的无标记方法。在这些方法中，基于深度学习的无标记虚拟染色利用未染色组织的图像，通过计算生成染色图像。尽管关注度不断上升，模型的开发与验证仍受限于配对的、带有临床标注的全切片成像数据集的匮乏。我们提出了 BRIDGE，这是一个在波兰比得哥什的 Prof. Franciszek Lukaszczyk 肿瘤中心收集的前列腺穿刺活检数据集。该数据集包含来自 169 名患者的 869 张玻片，每张玻片在切片、脱蜡和苏木精-伊红染色后依次进行数字化，共获得 2607 张全切片图像。该数据集支持无标记虚拟染色、虚拟去染色、图像配准和分割方法的开发与外部验证。每张玻片均附有 Gleason 评分，可用于癌症分类和分级一致性的下游分析。染色图像也可单独用于颜色归一化和跨扫描仪稳健性研究。所有图像均已去标识化，以其原生扫描仪格式分发，并将通过 BioImage Archive 提供。

title: An evidence-traceable benchmark of clinical reasoning in large language models
zh_title: 可溯源证据的大模型临床推理基准 MEB
summary: 构建含1,536道医师编写题目的Med Evidence Bench，评分标准链接到版本化证据文本，评测十个大模型在不同层级的表现。
key_points: 三层结构：指南知识、标准化场景、真实检验场景
真实场景中识别信息得分高于证据匹配与建议制定
reason: 新医学LLM基准、评测较充分，但为预印本；摘要未见数据开放细节
abstract: Benchmark scores for medical large language models (LLMs) are difficult to interpret when scoring criteria cannot be traced to clinical evidence. Here we developed Med Evidence Bench (MEB; https://www.medevidencebench.org.cn/), comprising 1,536 physician-constructed items across three levels: guideline knowledge, standardized clinical scenarios and real-world laboratory scenarios. Each criterion stating a medical claim is linked to a versioned source-text span. Across ten LLMs, the Evidence Trace Score (ETS) was 0.975-0.997 for guideline knowledge, 0.292-0.658 for standardized scenarios and 0.182-0.447 for real-world scenarios, and rankings varied across levels. For real-world scenarios, scores for identifying clinical information (mean, 0.770) exceeded those for matching evidence (0.165) or formulating recommendations (0.160). On 1,296 criterion-level judgments, automated grading agreed with the majority vote of three physicians (macro-F1, 0.930; 95% confidence interval, 0.915-0.945), although agreement was lower for evidence application. These findings from Chinese-language materials indicate that guideline recall does not ensure patient-specific evidence use and do not establish clinical effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 当评分标准无法追溯到临床证据时，医学大语言模型（LLM）的基准测试分数难以解读。为此，我们开发了 Med Evidence Bench（MEB；https://www.medevidencebench.org.cn/），包含由医师构建的 1,536 个条目，分为三个层级：指南知识、标准化临床情景和真实世界实验室情景。每条陈述医学论断的标准均与带版本的来源文本片段相关联。在十个 LLM 中，证据追溯评分（Evidence Trace Score，ETS）在指南知识层级为 0.975-0.997，在标准化情景层级为 0.292-0.658，在真实世界情景层级为 0.182-0.447，且各层级的排名存在差异。在真实世界情景中，识别临床信息的得分（均值 0.770）高于匹配证据（0.165）或形成建议（0.160）的得分。在 1,296 项标准层面的判定中，自动评分与三名医师多数票的一致性为（macro-F1，0.930；95% 置信区间，0.915-0.945），但在证据应用方面一致性较低。这些基于中文材料的发现表明，对指南的回忆并不能保证针对具体患者的证据运用，也不能证明其临床有效性。

title: Interleaving anatomical inspection and diagnostic reasoning for explainable radiology report generation
zh_title: 交错解剖检查与诊断推理的可解释放射报告生成
summary: 预印本提出ARIVE框架，基于MIMIC-CXR构建15.9万条多模态思维链轨迹，并用解剖与临床内容奖励优化，报告生成优于基线。
key_points: 构建159,416条多模态思维链轨迹
解剖检查与诊断推理交错进行
在MIMIC-CXR上临床效能优于基线
reason: 新方法与大规模轨迹数据，对比基线；预印本，来源未见外部验证
abstract: Automated radiology report generation can draft clinically plausible reports, yet the pathway from visual evidence to reported findings remains opaque, leaving the diagnostic basis of these reports unexplained and the generated reports difficult to review or revise. We introduce ARIVE (Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence), an explainable report generation framework that interleaves anatomical inspection with diagnostic reasoning prior to final report composition. To support this process, we constructed 159,416 multimodal chain-of-thought (MCoT) trajectories from MIMIC-CXR, wherein visual evidence from inspected anatomical regions informs subsequent clinical interpretation. Trained on these trajectories and further optimized using anatomical and clinical-content rewards, ARIVE achieved superior clinical-efficacy performance compared with strong baselines on MIMIC-CXR and the abnormality-centered MIMIC-ABN. ARIVE's reports were competitive with those of leading models in blinded expert grading, and its MCoT trajectories earned high ratings for diagnostic traceability. Furthermore, a paired review evaluation suggests that access to MCoT can aid in identifying errors within generated reports.
zh_abstract: 自动放射学报告生成能够起草临床上合理的报告，但从视觉证据到报告所述发现的路径仍不透明，导致这些报告的诊断依据无法解释，生成的报告也难以审阅或修订。我们提出了 ARIVE（Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence，解剖学引导的交错视觉证据推理），这是一种可解释的报告生成框架，在最终报告撰写之前，将解剖结构检查与诊断推理交错进行。为支持这一过程，我们基于 MIMIC-CXR 构建了 159,416 条多模态思维链（MCoT）轨迹，其中来自已检查解剖区域的视觉证据为后续的临床解读提供依据。ARIVE 在这些轨迹上进行训练，并通过解剖学和临床内容奖励进一步优化，在 MIMIC-CXR 以及以异常为中心的 MIMIC-ABN 上，其临床效能表现优于强基线模型。在盲法专家评分中，ARIVE 生成的报告与领先模型相比具有竞争力，其 MCoT 轨迹在诊断可追溯性方面获得了高评分。此外，一项配对审阅评估提示，借助 MCoT 有助于识别生成报告中的错误。

title: SepsisFlow: an event-stream foundation model for continuous risk warning and trajectory modelling in ICU sepsis
zh_title: SepsisFlow：用于ICU脓毒症连续预警与轨迹建模的事件流基础模型
summary: 预印本提出SepsisFlow，基于257万份电子病历预训练的Mamba模型，覆盖脓毒症发病前预警、发病情境及发病后早期病程建模；在MIMIC-IV中同等警报数下检出率高于NEWS2、qSOFA和SIRS。
key_points: Mamba在257万份EHR上预训练，结合约1700项每小时特征
统一小时时钟覆盖发病前、发病时、发病后
MIMIC-IV中同等警报下检出多于NEWS2等评分
reason: 大规模预训练EHR基础模型有新意，但摘要仅见MIMIC-IV验证，预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Sepsis is a leading cause of ICU death with heterogeneous onset and course, yet most warning models predict only whether sepsis will occur, leaving clinicians uncertain of its onset context and early trajectory once an alarm sounds. To answer these questions on one hourly clock from ICU admission, we built SepsisFlow: before onset, it combines a Mamba model pretrained on 2.57 million EHRs with about 1,700 hourly features in gradient-boosted trees to predict 6/12/24-h risk; at onset, it fuses Mamba and tabular encoders via a gated network into continuous patient states defining onset contexts; after onset, it encodes 72-h organ-support and physiological trajectories via an attention bidirectional recurrent network into early courses. For pre-onset warning in MIMIC-IV, SepsisFlow detected more cases than NEWS2, qSOFA, and SIRS at equal alarms, gaining about 8 cases per 100 from hourly updating, while outperforming 16 retrained algorithms and maintaining risk ranking in eICU. At onset, its contexts separated 2% cardiovascular-ICU from 15%-17% other 28-day mortality, and within each context after onset, persistent support carried fivefold higher mortality than de-escalation. SepsisFlow establishes a foundation-model paradigm for continuous risk and trajectory stratification in critical care.
zh_abstract: 脓毒症是重症监护病房（ICU）死亡的主要原因之一，其发病和病程具有异质性，但大多数预警模型仅预测脓毒症是否会发生，使临床医生在警报响起后仍不清楚其发病情境和早期轨迹。为了在从ICU入院起的同一小时时间轴上回答这些问题，我们构建了SepsisFlow：在发病前，它将在257万份电子健康记录（EHR）上预训练的Mamba模型与约1,700个逐小时特征结合于梯度提升树中，以预测6/12/24小时风险；在发病时，它通过门控网络融合Mamba编码器与表格编码器，形成定义发病情境的连续患者状态；在发病后，它通过注意力双向循环网络对72小时的器官支持和生理轨迹进行编码，以得到早期病程。在MIMIC-IV的发病前预警中，在警报次数相同的情况下，SepsisFlow比NEWS2、qSOFA和SIRS检出更多病例，逐小时更新使每100例病例多检出约8例，同时优于16种重新训练的算法，并在eICU中保持了风险排序能力。在发病时，其划分的情境将心血管ICU的28天死亡率（2%）与其他情境的28天死亡率（15%–17%）区分开；在发病后的每个情境内，持续的器官支持其死亡率比降级支持高五倍。SepsisFlow为重症监护中的连续风险和轨迹分层建立了基础模型范式。

title: Predicting Single-Cell Spatial Gene Expression from H&E using Pathology Foundation Models
zh_title: 利用病理基础模型从H&E预测单细胞空间基因表达
summary: 预印本系统评估病理基础模型适配单细胞空间基因表达预测的策略，使用配对H&E与Xenium 5K数据，平均基因相关性较零样本基线提升2.67倍。
key_points: 使用配对H&E与Xenium 5K数据
平均逐基因Pearson相关较零样本基线提升2.67倍
全基因panel检测AUROC为0.800
reason: 病理基础模型适配新方法，有基线对比，但为预印本且证据有限
abstract: Predicting gene expression directly from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images offers a scalable and cost-effective approach to deriving spatial molecular insights from routine histology. Pathology foundation models, typically pretrained using tile-level objectives, may not adequately capture the fine-grained cellular features required for single-cell molecular prediction. In this work, we systematically evaluate and establish domain-informed and task-specific strategies for adapting pathology foundation models to single-cell spatial gene expression prediction. Using paired H&E and Xenium 5K data, our approach improves mean gene-wise Pearson correlation by 2.67x over the standard zero-shot baseline and achieves state-of-the-art performance on this task. We demonstrate strong gene-detection performance across the full gene panel (AUROC = 0.800) and importantly identify that predictive performance varies substantially across biological contexts, with our model achieving its highest Pearson correlation for spatially variable genes (r = 0.643). Our findings demonstrate that, despite the challenges of sparse single-cell measurements, H&E-derived representations can recover biologically meaningful spatial expression patterns, highlighting both the opportunities and limitations of morphology-based molecular inference at cellular resolution.
zh_abstract: 直接从苏木精-伊红（H&E）图像预测基因表达，为从常规组织学中获得空间分子信息提供了一种可扩展且经济有效的方法。病理基础模型通常采用图块级目标进行预训练，可能无法充分捕捉单细胞分子预测所需的细粒度细胞特征。在这项工作中，我们系统评估并确立了将病理基础模型适配于单细胞空间基因表达预测的领域知识引导和任务特异性策略。利用配对的H&E和Xenium 5K数据，我们的方法将基因层面的平均Pearson相关系数相比标准零样本基线提高了2.67倍，并在该任务上达到了最先进的性能。我们在整个基因panel上展示了较强的基因检测性能（AUROC = 0.800），并且重要的是发现预测性能在不同生物学情境间差异显著，其中我们的模型在空间可变基因上取得最高的Pearson相关系数（r = 0.643）。我们的研究结果表明，尽管单细胞测量存在稀疏性的挑战，源自H&E的表征仍可恢复具有生物学意义的空间表达模式，凸显了在细胞分辨率下基于形态学进行分子推断的机遇与局限。

title: Drug Design and Discovery: The Long Road From Hansch Analysis to Artificial Intelligence.
zh_title: 药物设计与发现：从Hansch分析到人工智能的漫长道路
summary: 综述回顾QSAR从早期数据分析到当前机器学习与AI的演变，涵盖分子表示、描述符激增及药物发现各阶段的应用，并提及建模的严格前提。

abstract: [ChemMedChem] The present article traces the long journey of the historical evolution and transformation of QSAR from its early days to its current role in drug discovery. It begins with the breakthrough created by the introduction of data analysis and highlights the major advances achieved throughout its development. Changes in molecular representation resulted in an explosion of molecular descriptors, while the rapid accumulation of large amounts of data demanded the application of elaborated statistical techniques. Today, machine learning and artificial intelligence have become integral components of pharmaceutical research, supporting every stage of the drug discovery pipeline, from target identification and hit discovery to lead optimization and the prediction of ADMET properties. At the same time, strict prerequisites have been established to ensure the development of QSAR models capable of reliable and robust predictions. Model validation, applicability domain, and model interpretability are fundamental principles of robust QSAR modeling. These principles are closely related to the distinction between local and global models, reflecting the trade-off between predictive performance, generalizability, and mechanistic interpretability. Finally, multi-objective optimization is discussed, as an approach to address the complex and often conflicting requirements, associated with successful drug candidates and decision-making throughout the drug discovery pipeline, including library design.
zh_abstract: [ChemMedChem] 本文回顾了定量构效关系（QSAR）从早期到其在药物发现中当前作用的漫长历史演变与转变历程。文章从数据分析引入所带来的突破谈起，并强调其发展过程中取得的主要进展。分子表示方式的变化导致分子描述符激增，而大量数据的快速积累则要求应用精细的统计技术。如今，机器学习和人工智能已成为药物研究不可或缺的组成部分，支持药物发现流程的每个阶段，从靶点识别、苗头化合物发现到先导化合物优化以及 ADMET 性质预测。与此同时，为确保所建立的 QSAR 模型能够进行可靠而稳健的预测，已确立了严格的前提条件。模型验证、适用域和模型可解释性是稳健 QSAR 建模的基本原则。这些原则与局部模型和全局模型的区别密切相关，反映了预测性能、泛化能力和机制可解释性之间的权衡。最后，文章讨论了多目标优化，作为应对成功候选药物所面临的复杂且常常相互冲突的要求以及整个药物发现流程（包括库设计）中决策的一种方法。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Visual Mapping of Viable and Necrotic Tissue During Wound Debridement: A Clinical Image Segmentation Study.

key_points: 回顾性临床清创图像像素级标注

abstract: [Annals of plastic surgery] Accurate distinction between viable and necrotic tissue is essential during wound debridement, but visual assessment may be affected by blood coverage, uneven illumination, blurred tissue transitions, and instrument occlusion. This study developed and evaluated a deep learning-assisted image segmentation method for wound tissue assessment. A retrospective data set of clinical wound debridement images was annotated at the pixel level as background, viable or preservable tissue, and necrotic or nonviable tissue. Tissue-aware copy-paste augmentation was used to improve necrotic tissue representation. A SegFormer-based semantic segmentation model with boundary-aware output was trained and evaluated using pixel accuracy, intersection over union (IoU), Dice coefficient, precision, recall, and boundary F1 score. The augmented data set contained 356 image-mask pairs, including 156 original and 200 synthesized pairs. Training, validation, and test sets included 249, 53, and 54 samples, respectively. On the test set, pixel accuracy was 98.01%. For viable and necrotic tissue, mean IoU and mean Dice were 85.97% and 92.45%, respectively. Dice scores were 92.24% for viable tissue and 92.67% for necrotic tissue. Necrotic tissue recall was 94.09%, and mean boundary F1 was 61.83%. The proposed method showed strong region-level agreement with expert annotations and high sensitivity for necrotic tissue. Color-coded prediction maps and overlay visualizations may support wound tissue assessment, although exact boundary localization remained less accurate. Larger independent clinical data sets are needed for further validation.
zh_abstract: [Annals of plastic surgery] 在伤口清创过程中，准确区分存活组织与坏死组织至关重要，但视觉评估可能受到血液覆盖、光照不均、组织过渡模糊和器械遮挡的影响。本研究开发并评估了一种用于伤口组织评估的深度学习辅助图像分割方法。对临床伤口清创图像的回顾性数据集进行像素级标注，分为背景、存活或可保留组织、以及坏死或失活组织。采用组织感知的复制粘贴增强以改善坏死组织的代表性。训练并评估了一个基于 SegFormer、带有边界感知输出的语义分割模型，评价指标包括像素准确率、交并比（IoU）、Dice 系数、精确率、召回率和边界 F1 分数。增强后的数据集包含 356 个图像-掩码对，其中 156 个为原始数据、200 个为合成数据。训练集、验证集和测试集分别包含 249、53 和 54 个样本。在测试集上，像素准确率为 98.01%。对于存活组织和坏死组织，平均 IoU 和平均 Dice 分别为 85.97% 和 92.45%。存活组织的 Dice 为 92.24%，坏死组织的 Dice 为 92.67%。坏死组织召回率为 94.09%，平均边界 F1 为 61.83%。所提方法与专家标注在区域层面显示出高度一致性，且对坏死组织具有较高敏感性。彩色编码的预测图和叠加可视化可能有助于伤口组织评估，但精确的边界定位仍欠准确。需要更大规模的独立临床数据集进行进一步验证。

abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping cardiovascular medicine by transforming routinely collected clinical data into tools for earlier disease detection and more precise phenotyping. Heart failure (HF) represents a particularly compelling opportunity for AI-driven innovation, as many patients with structural heart disease remain unrecognized and traditional diagnostic frameworks often fail to capture disease heterogeneity. AI-enabled electrocardiogram (ECG) models, including EchoNext and PRESENT-SHD, highlight the potential for scalable opportunistic screening strategies for structural heart disease. Multimodal approaches, using ECGs and echocardiograms, are enabling earlier recognition of specific HF phenotypes, such as transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis. Successful implementation of these technologies will require prospective evaluation, thoughtful workflow integration, and responsible deployment. Early-career cardiologists are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation of AI in clinical medicine, ensuring that AI serves as a tool to augment clinical reasoning and ultimately advances more personalized, patient-centered cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: [心力衰竭杂志] 人工智能（AI）正在通过将常规收集的临床数据转化为用于更早期疾病检测和更精确表型分型的工具，重塑心血管医学。心力衰竭（HF）是AI驱动创新的一个特别有吸引力的领域，因为许多结构性心脏病患者仍未被识别，且传统诊断框架往往无法反映疾病的异质性。包括 EchoNext 和 PRESENT-SHD 在内的AI赋能心电图（ECG）模型，凸显了可扩展的结构性心脏病机会性筛查策略的潜力。结合心电图和超声心动图的多模态方法，正在促进对特定HF表型（如转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变性）的更早识别。这些技术的成功实施需要前瞻性评估、周全的工作流程整合以及负责任的部署。早期职业阶段的心脏病学医生具有独特的优势来引领AI在临床医学中的这一变革，确保AI成为增强临床推理的工具，并最终推动更加个体化、以患者为中心的心血管诊疗。

title: From clinical negligence to digital healthcare harm: A medico-legal framework for liability assessment in the era of artificial intelligence, telemedicine and cybersecurity.
source: PubMed · Medicine, science, and the law

summary: 文章提出“数字医疗损害”概念及四层社会技术责任框架，用于AI、远程医疗与网络安全相关不良事件的法医学责任评估。
key_points: 提出Digital Healthcare Harm分析类别

用于因果关系与责任的重建

abstract: [Medicine, science, and the law] Healthcare is increasingly mediated by artificial intelligence, telemedicine platforms, electronic health records, cloud-based infrastructures and cybersecurity architectures. These technologies create new opportunities for care delivery, but also new pathways through which patients may be harmed. This article proposes Digital Healthcare Harm as an analytical category for the medico-legal assessment of adverse events arising wholly or partially from interactions between healthcare professionals, healthcare organisations, digital technologies and digital infrastructures. It further introduces a Socio-Technical Liability Framework structured around four layers: the clinical actor, the healthcare organisation, the digital technology and the digital infrastructure. The framework is intended to support the forensic and medico-legal reconstruction of causation, foreseeability, control, preventability and responsibility allocation in digitally mediated healthcare. It does not replace existing doctrines of professional negligence, organisational liability or product liability, but provides a structured method for analysing how these doctrines may interact in complex digital healthcare ecosystems. By integrating artificial intelligence, telemedicine and cybersecurity within a single medico-legal model, the article aims to assist legal medicine practitioners, forensic experts and healthcare institutions in assessing liability where patient harm cannot be adequately explained by clinician conduct alone.
zh_abstract: [医学、科学与法律] 医疗保健日益由人工智能、远程医疗平台、电子健康记录、基于云的基础设施和网络安全架构所介导。这些技术为医疗服务的提供创造了新的机会，同时也带来了患者可能受到伤害的新途径。本文提出“数字医疗伤害”（Digital Healthcare Harm）作为一种分析类别，用于对全部或部分源于医务人员、医疗机构、数字技术与数字基础设施之间相互作用的不良事件进行医学法律评估。本文进一步提出一个围绕四个层面构建的社会技术责任框架（Socio-Technical Liability Framework）：临床行为人、医疗机构、数字技术和数字基础设施。该框架旨在支持在数字化介导的医疗保健中，对因果关系、可预见性、控制、可预防性和责任分配进行法医学和医学法律层面的重构。它并不取代现有的职业过失、组织责任或产品责任理论，而是提供一种结构化方法，用以分析这些理论在复杂的数字医疗生态系统中可能如何相互作用。通过在单一医学法律模型中整合人工智能、远程医疗和网络安全，本文旨在帮助法医学从业者、法医专家和医疗机构评估那些仅凭临床医生行为无法充分解释患者伤害的情形下的责任。

title: Artificial Intelligence‒Guided Phenotyping of Cardiomyopathies: From Detection to Surveillance.
zh_title: AI引导的心肌病表型分析：从检测到监测

abstract: [Journal of cardiac failure] The management of cardiomyopathies relies on timely diagnosis, precise phenotyping, multimodal risk stratification, and longitudinal monitoring. These tasks require integration of high-dimensional signals from patient history, electrocardiography, imaging, biomarkers, and longitudinal health records, data streams well-suited to artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled pattern recognition and prediction. Among inherited and acquired cardiomyopathies, hypertrophic (HCM) and transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) best exemplify this opportunity. Both remain systematically underdiagnosed, span a continuous phenotypic spectrum, and are increasingly actionable through disease-modifying therapies. Emerging AI approaches applied to multimodality data streams can identify latent disease, quantify its severity, and predict its trajectory. Beyond diagnosis, AI paves the path for opportunistic screening, longitudinal surveillance, risk stratification, and novel clinical trial designs. Realizing this promise requires careful attention to label quality, generalizability, false-positive burden in low-prevalence settings, and prospective evidence that the human-AI synergy improves outcomes. In this review, we use HCM and ATTR-CM as key examples to synthesize the current evidence of AI in cardiomyopathies and propose a forward-looking framework for AI-guided disease phenotyping, with emphasis on regulation, implementation, and clinical evaluation.
zh_abstract: [心力衰竭杂志] 心肌病的管理依赖于及时诊断、精确表型分型、多模态风险分层以及纵向监测。这些任务需要整合来自患者病史、心电图、影像、生物标志物和纵向健康记录的高维信号，而这些数据流非常适合人工智能（AI）驱动的模式识别与预测。在遗传性和获得性心肌病中，肥厚型心肌病（HCM）和转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变心肌病（ATTR-CM）最能体现这一机遇。两者均仍被系统性漏诊，表型呈连续谱，并且越来越多地可通过疾病修饰治疗进行干预。应用于多模态数据流的新兴 AI 方法能够识别潜在疾病、量化其严重程度并预测其病程轨迹。除诊断外，AI 还为机会性筛查、纵向监测、风险分层和新型临床试验设计铺平了道路。要实现这一前景，需要认真关注标签质量、可推广性、低患病率情境下的假阳性负担，以及证明人机协同可改善结局的前瞻性证据。在本综述中，我们以 HCM 和 ATTR-CM 为主要范例，综合 AI 在心肌病中的现有证据，并提出一个面向未来的 AI 引导疾病表型分型框架，重点关注监管、实施和临床评估。

title: Artificial intelligence in the in vitro fertilization laboratory: A scoping review and SWOT-based evaluation of emerging applications.
source: PubMed · Clinical and experimental reproductive medicine

abstract: [Clinical and experimental reproductive medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) represents a potentially transformative tool in assisted reproductive technology (ART), particularly in vitro fertilization (IVF), for gamete assessment, embryo selection, non-invasive genetic testing, and laboratory automation. This scoping review synthesized recent evidence on AI applications in IVF laboratories and evaluated their translational maturity using an evidence maturity framework and a strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats (SWOT) analysis. This scoping review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) Extension for Scoping Reviews guidelines. PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched for peer-reviewed studies published from January 2020 to February 2025. Eligible studies evaluated AI, machine learning, or deep learning in laboratory components of ART. Data were charted on AI methods, dataset characteristics, validation strategies, clinical endpoints, and performance metrics. Ninety-four studies were included. Most applications addressed embryo grading and implantation prediction using convolutional neural networks and were evaluated through internal cross-validation. Reported areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve ranged from 0.75 to 0.92, depending on the endpoint and dataset size. AI applications in sperm analysis and oocyte assessment showed greater reproducibility than manual evaluation. Non-invasive genetic prediction models displayed promising but heterogeneous sensitivity and remained predominantly limited to internal validation. Few studies reported prospective evaluation or external validation using multicenter datasets. AI applications in IVF are expanding, but most remain at early stages of clinical translation. Standardized datasets, external validation, interpretable algorithms, and regulatory oversight remain necessary for safe, equitable clinical integration. AI should function as a decision-support tool that supplements, rather than replaces, embryologists' expertise.
zh_abstract: [临床与实验生殖医学] 人工智能（AI）是辅助生殖技术（ART），特别是体外受精（IVF）中一种具有潜在变革性的工具，可用于配子评估、胚胎选择、无创遗传检测和实验室自动化。本范围综述综合了 AI 在 IVF 实验室中应用的近期证据，并采用证据成熟度框架和优势、劣势、机遇与威胁（SWOT）分析评估其转化成熟度。本范围综述遵循系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）范围综述扩展版指南。检索了 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 中 2020 年 1 月至 2025 年 2 月发表的同行评审研究。符合条件的研究评估了 AI、机器学习或深度学习在 ART 实验室环节中的应用。对 AI 方法、数据集特征、验证策略、临床终点和性能指标进行了资料提取。共纳入 94 项研究。大多数应用涉及使用卷积神经网络进行胚胎分级和着床预测，并通过内部交叉验证进行评估。根据终点和数据集规模不同，报告的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.75 至 0.92。AI 在精子分析和卵母细胞评估中的应用显示出比人工评估更高的可重复性。无创遗传预测模型的敏感度前景可期但存在异质性，且仍主要局限于内部验证。很少有研究报告前瞻性评估或使用多中心数据集的外部验证。AI 在 IVF 中的应用正在扩展，但大多数仍处于临床转化的早期阶段。要实现安全、公平的临床整合，仍需要标准化数据集、外部验证、可解释算法和监管监督。AI 应作为辅助而非取代胚胎学家专业能力的决策支持工具。

abstract: [Veterinary pathology] Counting ovarian early follicles helps assess the impact of pharmaceuticals and endocrine-disrupting chemicals on female fertility. Traditional manual counting methods are labor-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to intra- and interobserver variability, leading to inconsistent results. This study addresses these limitations by developing a fully automated solution for the identification and quantification of early-stage follicles in hematoxylin and eosin-stained rat ovarian sections, with the aim of enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and reproducibility. We developed a deep learning model designed to identify primordial type 1 and type 2 follicles, and a second model focusing on detecting early growing follicles. The automated system exhibited high performance on an independent test data set of 200 whole-slide images, whose predictions were validated by pathologists. The models achieved high precision and recall, with 98.49% and 90.92%, respectively, for type 1; 95.97% and 97.54% for type 2; and 99.45% and 80.09% for early growing follicles. Further comparisons with manual annotations performed by 4 independent pathologists revealed significant interobserver variability. While human performance was hindered by factors such as fatigue and inconsistent criteria application, resulting in variable precision and recall and high rates of missed follicles, the algorithm maintained superior consistency and overall higher F1-scores. Furthermore, a comparison between manual work and the algorithm's productivity showed that the algorithm was 11 times faster than manual quantification. These results demonstrate that the automated approach not only matches expert accuracy but also effectively eliminates subjectivity and diagnostic drift inherent in manual counting, providing a reproducible method for follicle counting, and significantly enhancing workflow efficiency.
zh_abstract: [兽医病理学] 卵巢早期卵泡计数有助于评估药物和内分泌干扰化学物质对女性生育力的影响。传统的人工计数方法费力、耗时，且存在观察者内和观察者间差异，导致结果不一致。本研究针对这些局限，开发了一种全自动解决方案，用于识别和定量苏木精-伊红染色的大鼠卵巢切片中的早期卵泡，旨在提高效率、准确性和可重复性。我们开发了一个用于识别原始卵泡1型和2型的深度学习模型，以及另一个专注于检测早期生长卵泡的模型。该自动化系统在包含200张全切片图像的独立测试数据集上表现出色，其预测结果经病理学家验证。模型取得了较高的精确率和召回率：1型分别为98.49%和90.92%；2型分别为95.97%和97.54%；早期生长卵泡分别为99.45%和80.09%。与4名独立病理学家进行的人工标注进一步比较显示，观察者间存在显著差异。人工表现受疲劳和标准应用不一致等因素影响，导致精确率和召回率不稳定，且漏检卵泡的比例较高，而该算法保持了更优的一致性和总体更高的F1分数。此外，人工工作与算法效率的比较表明，该算法比人工定量快11倍。这些结果表明，该自动化方法不仅可达到专家水平的准确性，还能有效消除人工计数中固有的主观性和诊断漂移，提供了一种可重复的卵泡计数方法，并显著提高了工作流程效率。

title: Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
zh_title: 环境 AI 记录员评估方法高度碎片化
summary: 对54项环境 AI 记录员评估研究的梳理发现，共有十个评估维度和40项指标，被操作化为96种方式，其中36%仅被单一研究使用。
key_points: 44/54项研究以文书效率和时间为主
安全性与临床结局的评估最不一致
缺乏统一的评估协议与标准化指标
reason: 有信息量的综述类研究，指出评估标准缺口，综述类上限6
abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. Ripple effects on the broader care system, such as impact on patients' care outcomes, redistribution of work, changes in billing and coding intensity, and downstream use of notes by other clinicians are rarely assessed. Moreover, the metrics used rely heavily on self-report and are fragmented and inconsistently operationalized, which limits comparability and hinders synthesis across studies. As an effort to support more rigorous and cumulative evaluation, in this paper we review the study designs, data sources, and metrics commonly used to evaluate ambient AI scribes in healthcare settings, discuss the limitations of current evaluation practice, and argue for a more holistic approach grounded in a standardized, multi-dimensional set of metrics.

title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
zh_title: EM-DETR示例引导的病灶检测基础模型
summary: 提出学生-教师策略整合异构标注的多域医学影像数据集，并在EM-DETR框架上构建多域病灶检测基础模型（预印本）。
key_points: 学生-教师训练合并异构标签空间
缓解灾难性遗忘并改善特征学习
基于示例引导的EM-DETR框架扩展
reason: 新方法预印本，基础检测模型方向，证据有限
abstract: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated datasets. In medical lesion detection, the scarcity of comprehensive, stan dardized annotations and the heterogeneity of existing datasets limit the development of robust foundation models. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to building a multi-domain foundation model for le sion detection by integrating diverse medical image datasets annotated for both anatomical structures and abnormalities. We first propose a student-teacher training strategy to effectively combine datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and im proving feature learning. In addition, building on our previously pro posed example-based EM-DETR framework, we adapt it to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets, enabling fine-grained, example driven detection across modalities. Our model achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, with image-level AUC scores exceeding previous SOTA by 1% point on four key findings in CXRs. We achieve a leading mAP50 in CXRs and mammography, surpassing EM-DETR trained on a single dataset by 2-3% points. This approach paves the way for scalable foundation models in medical imaging that leverage heterogeneous data while maintaining robust and generalizable performance.
zh_abstract: 基于深度学习（DL）的计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统在辅助临床医生方面展现出巨大潜力，但其性能在很大程度上依赖于大规模、标注良好的数据集。在医学病灶检测中，全面、标准化标注的稀缺以及现有数据集的异质性限制了稳健基础模型的发展。在本研究中，我们提出了一种构建多领域病灶检测基础模型的新方法，即整合同时标注了解剖结构和异常的多种医学影像数据集。我们首先提出一种学生-教师训练策略，以有效合并标签空间异质的数据集，缓解灾难性遗忘并改善特征学习。此外，在我们先前提出的基于示例的 EM-DETR 框架的基础上，我们对其进行改进，使其能够从多个特定领域数据集中联合学习，从而实现跨模态的细粒度、基于示例的检测。我们的模型取得了最先进（SOTA）的结果：在胸部X线片（CXR）的四项关键发现上，图像级 AUC 得分比之前的 SOTA 高出 1 个百分点。我们在 CXR 和乳腺X线摄影中取得了领先的 mAP50，比仅在单一数据集上训练的 EM-DETR 高出 2-3 个百分点。该方法为医学影像中可扩展的基础模型铺平了道路，使其能够利用异质数据，同时保持稳健且可泛化的性能。

title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
zh_title: 对比式发现：基于竞争性解释的开放式科学发现
summary: 提出以互斥且穷尽的竞争性解释集合替代单一假设，让LLM智能体按证据对信念的再分配来评分和收敛。
key_points: 现有智能体仅对假设与其补集做逐点检验
对比集合可用于重评已收集证据或引导搜索
在六个数据集上评测（摘要未给出更多细节）
reason: 科学发现智能体新方法，有评测但为预印本，与医疗关联较间接
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地用于开放式的、数据驱动的科学发现，但其中大多数以逐点方式评估假设，即仅将一个经验性论断 $h$ 与其补集 $\neg h$ 进行检验。当证据否定 $h$ 时，智能体只能得知某一种解释不太可能成立，却不知道证据支持哪一种替代解释。为了找回这一替代解释，我们提出对比式发现（Contrastive Discovery），用对比集取代单一假设；对比集由一个科学问题及一组互斥且穷尽的竞争性解释构成。每个实验依据其证据如何在该集合内重新分配信念来评分，当信念集中于某一种解释时，该问题即被解决。由于对比集只改变智能体提出和评分的单位，现有智能体可以利用它们对已收集的证据重新评估，或用以指导搜索。在六个领域中，信念变化最大的逐点候选假设里有 $89\%$ 为被否定的假设。在相同证据下，对比集将这些候选中的 $73\%$ 解析到了具体的替代解释。当由对比集指导搜索时，在相同实验预算下，智能体解决的问题比逐点惊奇度（surprisal）方法多 $67\%$。在一项盲法研究中，$38$ 名人类专家在 $78\%$ 的已解决问题上选择了相同的解释；在逐点智能体否定其假设并停止的问题中，这一比例为 $82\%$。综上，这些结果支持将显式的竞争性解释作为一种方式，使发现型智能体能在相同的证据和验证预算下解决更多科学问题。

title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
zh_title: 面向心血管疾病检测的偏差感知心电图预训练
summary: 提出基于近百万条无标注12导联心电图的自监督框架，含偏差定位与关联重建模块，报告AUROC最高提升6.5%。
key_points: 用近百万条无标注12导联心电图预训练
DLE检测波形偏差，ARE建模跨导联关联
AUROC最高提升6.5%，F1亦有提升
reason: 大规模自监督心电预训练，预印本，外部验证未明
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public datasets, even without additional fine-tuning the pretrained feature extractor. Embedding visualizations show that the learned features support meaningful disease grouping and anomaly identification. The approach reduces the need for labeled data and can support clinicians in diverse healthcare settings. The framework has potential to improve early detection and monitoring of cardiovascular diseases, contributing to more accessible and equitable heart care.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）信号对心血管疾病（CVD）的检测至关重要。目前大多数深度学习模型依赖于有监督的、针对特定任务的训练，这限制了其在不同疾病、患者人群和采集环境之间的泛化能力。本文提出了一种自监督心电图特征提取框架，该框架从近一百万条未标注的12导联心电图记录中学习。该框架包含两个模块：偏差定位嵌入（Deviation Localization Embedding，DLE），用于检测波形层面偏离正常模式的情况；以及关联重建嵌入（Association Reconstruction Embedding，ARE），通过偏差引导的重建对跨导联关联进行建模，以捕捉在多个导联中表现出的异常模式。这些模块使该框架能够捕捉细微的偏差相关模式及其跨导联上下文。即使不对预训练的特征提取器进行额外微调，该框架在多个公开数据集上相比既往方法仍取得最高达 6.5% 的 AUROC 提升和 12.8% 的 F1 提升。嵌入可视化显示，所学特征支持有意义的疾病分组和异常识别。该方法减少了对标注数据的需求，可为不同医疗环境中的临床医生提供支持。该框架有望改善心血管疾病的早期检测和监测，有助于实现更可及、更公平的心脏医疗。

title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Aware Framework for Trustworthy Molecular Property Prediction
zh_title: Chem World：面向可信分子性质预测的大规模基准与物理感知框架
summary: 提出整合17个公开数据集、逾80万实例、10类性质的分子性质预测基准，并提出物理感知组合建模方法PACM。
key_points: 涵盖单分子与多组分体系，含药物溶解度
统一评估分子表示与组合建模
提出结合物理约束的PACM方法
reason: 大规模基准有新意，但为预印本且偏化学
abstract: Molecular property prediction is fundamental to computational chemistry and drug formulation research, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across datasets, properties, and evaluation protocols, limiting systematic evaluation of model generalization. We introduce Chem World, a large-scale benchmark integrating 17 public datasets with over 800,000 molecular and chemical-system instances across 10 property tracks, covering single-molecule and multi-component systems, including drug solubility. Chem World provides a unified testbed for evaluating molecular representations and compositional modeling across diverse chemical properties. Building on the benchmark, we propose PACM (Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling), which combines molecular representations with composition-aware modeling and domain-specific physical constraints. Extensive experiments show that molecular language models provide strong and transferable representations, while PACM consistently improves prediction across diverse chemical systems. Chem World and our PACM-powered drug-property prediction Agent support generalizable chemical modeling and offer a foundation for AI-assisted biomedical research and drug formulation development.
zh_abstract: 分子性质预测是计算化学和药物制剂研究的基础，然而现有基准在数据集、性质和评估方案上仍较为分散，限制了对模型泛化能力的系统评估。我们提出了 Chem World，这是一个大规模基准，整合了17个公共数据集，包含超过800,000个分子及化学体系实例，涵盖10个性质赛道，涉及单分子体系和多组分体系，包括药物溶解度。Chem World 为评估不同化学性质下的分子表示和组成建模提供了统一的测试平台。在此基准基础上，我们提出了 PACM（Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling，物理感知组成建模），它将分子表示与组成感知建模及特定领域的物理约束相结合。大量实验表明，分子语言模型可提供强大且可迁移的表示，而 PACM 在多种化学体系中持续提升预测效果。Chem World 及我们基于 PACM 的药物性质预测智能体（Agent）支持可泛化的化学建模，并为人工智能辅助的生物医学研究和药物制剂开发提供了基础。

title: A Concept-Based Interpretable Framework for Clinical Text-based Prediction via Token-Concept Attention without Concept Supervision
zh_title: 无需概念监督的临床文本可解释预测：词元-概念注意力框架
summary: 提出基于交叉注意力瓶颈的框架，在无概念标注下为临床文本预测提供基于概念的解释。
key_points: 利用预训练语言模型嵌入文本与医学概念描述
交叉注意力估计各词元的概念相关性
无需昂贵的概念标注即可解释
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要未见充分验证结果
abstract: Objective: Concept-based interpretation has emerged as a promising approach for explaining blackbox models using human-understandable, high-level concepts. However, most existing methods require annotated concept labels to train the model to identify concepts in the input, and obtaining such annotations in clinical text is often expensive. This study aims to enable concept-based interpretation for language models without concept supervision on clinical prediction tasks. Methods: We propose a novel framework that enables concept-based interpretation without concept supervision through a tailored cross-attention bottleneck. Clinical text and the text descriptions of medical concepts are first tokenized and embedded by a pretrained language model. A cross-attention module then estimates the presence of each concept for each text token, producing concept relevance scores that capture how concepts are involved throughout the note. These scores are pooled and used in a linear prediction layer to model clinical outcomes in an interpretable manner. Results: The performance of the proposed framework was compared against blackbox models across two tasks: chest trauma severity stratification using a private dataset and an in-hospital mortality prediction task using the publicly available MIMIC-III dataset. The proposed framework achieved AUROC values within 0.02 of the corresponding blackbox models. The framework also enabled cohort- and patient-level interpretation, capturing the overall concept importance across the cohort and patient-specific concept contributions. Conclusion: Our proposed framework realizes concept-based interpretation without requiring ground-truth concept presence labels. It improves the transparency of clinical text predictions while maintaining strong performance in clinical prediction tasks.
zh_abstract: 【目的】基于概念的解释已成为一种有前景的方法，可利用人类可理解的高层概念来解释黑箱模型。然而，现有大多数方法需要带标注的概念标签来训练模型识别输入中的概念，而在临床文本中获取此类标注通常成本高昂。本研究旨在在临床预测任务中，实现无需概念监督的语言模型概念解释。【方法】我们提出了一种新颖的框架，通过定制的交叉注意力瓶颈（cross-attention bottleneck）实现无需概念监督的基于概念的解释。首先由预训练语言模型对临床文本和医学概念的文本描述进行分词和嵌入。随后，交叉注意力模块估计每个文本词元（token）中各概念的存在情况，生成概念相关性得分，以反映概念在整篇病历中的参与方式。这些得分经池化后输入线性预测层，以可解释的方式对临床结局建模。【结果】在两项任务中将所提框架与黑箱模型的性能进行了比较：使用私有数据集的胸部创伤严重程度分层，以及使用公开的 MIMIC-III 数据集的院内死亡率预测任务。所提框架的 AUROC 值与相应黑箱模型相差在 0.02 以内。该框架还能够实现队列层面和患者层面的解释，既可呈现整个队列中概念的总体重要性，也可呈现患者特异性的概念贡献。【结论】我们提出的框架无需真实概念存在标签即可实现基于概念的解释。它在保持临床预测任务强劲性能的同时，提高了临床文本预测的透明度。

title: DrugCoding: A Scientific Programming Agent for Drug Discovery
zh_title: DrugCoding：面向药物发现的科学编程智能体
summary: 提出集成任务规划、自适应模型路由、多智能体协作与程序化工具执行的药物发现智能体系统。
key_points: 针对分子设计、性质预测、虚拟筛选流程
含自适应模型路由与多智能体协作
通过编程方式执行多阶段科学计算
reason: 药物发现智能体新方法预印本，摘要未见评测细节，有方向加分
abstract: Drug discovery involves multiple interconnected research stages, including molecular design, property prediction, and virtual screening. These processes are characterized by complex workflows, interdependent computational tasks, and diverse specialized tools, placing substantial demands on the coordination of scientific models and computational resources. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents still face challenges in autonomous planning of complex tasks, adaptive selection of specialized models, and reliable execution of multi-stage scientific computations, limiting their effectiveness in automating complex drug discovery workflows. To address these challenges, we propose DrugCoding, a scientific programming agent system that integrates scientific task planning, adaptive model routing, multi-agent collaboration, and programmatic tool execution. DrugCoding enables autonomous task planning and dynamic model adaptation for complex research objectives. It can flexibly invoke specialized scientific models, autonomously generate and execute code according to task requirements, and leverage multi-agent collaboration to support efficient execution and reliable validation of complex scientific tasks. To evaluate DrugCoding's performance in scientific tool invocation and multi-stage task execution, we conduct multi-turn tool-calling experiments across diverse language models and scientific tool interfaces. Experimental results demonstrate that DrugCoding achieves an average session-level Pass@1 of 97.35% on the full benchmark, outperforming the strongest baseline, Codex, by 9.24%. On the challenging subset, DrugCoding achieves 97.92%, exceeding the strongest baseline.
zh_abstract: 药物发现涉及多个相互关联的研究阶段，包括分子设计、性质预测和虚拟筛选。这些过程具有工作流程复杂、计算任务相互依赖、专用工具多样等特点，对科学模型与计算资源的协调提出了很高要求。然而，现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的科学智能体在复杂任务的自主规划、专用模型的自适应选择以及多阶段科学计算的可靠执行方面仍面临挑战，限制了其在复杂药物发现工作流程自动化中的效果。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 DrugCoding，一种集成科学任务规划、自适应模型路由、多智能体协作和程序化工具执行的科学编程智能体系统。DrugCoding 能够针对复杂的研究目标实现自主任务规划和动态模型适配。它可以灵活调用专用科学模型，根据任务需求自主生成并执行代码，并借助多智能体协作支持复杂科学任务的高效执行和可靠验证。为评估 DrugCoding 在科学工具调用和多阶段任务执行方面的性能，我们在多种语言模型和科学工具接口上开展了多轮工具调用实验。实验结果表明，DrugCoding 在完整基准上的会话级平均 Pass@1 为 97.35%，比最强基线 Codex 高 9.24%。在高难度子集上，DrugCoding 达到 97.92%，超过最强基线。

title: MicroBT: Centroid-Guided Synergistic Learning for Multi-Modal Micro Brain Tumor Segmentation and Counting
zh_title: MicroBT：多模态微小脑肿瘤分割与计数
summary: 提出以质心为锚点的多模态框架，针对小于3毫米的微小脑肿瘤病灶进行分割与实例计数，缓解重叠类损失对小病灶的抑制。

abstract: Multi-modal brain tumor segmentation is essential for clinical diagnosis, radiotherapy planning, and longitudinal monitoring. While recent studies have achieved remarkable overall segmentation performance, they rely on overlap-based objectives that inherently favor large regions, causing sub-3 mm micro-lesions to be systematically suppressed during training. Moreover, existing pixel-level segmentation frameworks lack explicit instance-level modeling, leading to unreliable lesion counting that directly impacts clinical staging and therapeutic decisions. To address these challenges, we propose MicroBT, a unified multi-modal framework for micro brain tumor segmentation and counting. Our core insight is that a fundamental geometric property is inherently scale-invariant: regardless of size, each lesion possesses a well-defined centroid. Leveraging this, we first devise a centroid-anchored synergistic paradigm that utilizes predicted centroids as shared anchors to simultaneously condition dense segmentation and instance-level localization. To counteract the tumor size imbalance, we further devise a Volume-Calibrated Loss (VC-Loss) that adaptively amplifies the gradient contribution of micro-lesions, alongside a Size-Aware Curriculum Optimization (SACO) that stabilizes multi-task training by establishing global representations before progressively unlocking fine-grained localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MicroBT outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly on metastases, where micro-lesion ($\leq 3$ mm) localization precision improves by approximately 7% and counting estimation errors decrease by approximately 26%. The code is available at https://github.com/leonlou921/MicroBT.

title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
zh_title: FedVP：通过汇集本地验证器实现异构模型联邦学习
summary: 预印本提出联邦验证器池，各客户端本地训练验证器，服务器汇集其判断选答案而不聚合参数，在五个公开医学问答数据集上评估。
key_points: 异构LLM可通过共享验证协作
LLM骨干冻结，不合并参数
在五个公开医学问答数据集评估
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线评估但证据有限
abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qwen and LLaMA backbones ranging from 3B to 14B parameters. FEDVP consistently improves performance across all five clients and outperforms the strongest conventional federated baselines by 1.46-5.79 percentage points in mean accuracy.
zh_abstract: 传统联邦学习依赖共享的模型主干来聚合客户端更新，这限制了部署不同系列、不同规模大语言模型（LLM）的机构之间的协作。我们提出联邦验证器池（Federated Verifier Pool，FEDVP），这是一种新的联邦学习范式，使异构客户端能够通过共享验证而非参数聚合来协作。每个客户端使用本地数据以及其所选 LLM 主干生成的回答训练一个验证器。服务器汇集这些独立训练的验证器，并综合它们的判断来选择答案，而无需合并模型参数。这使得 LLM 主干和验证器在架构和规模上均可不同，同时保持 LLM 主干冻结，并从改进的答案选择中获得协作收益。我们在五个作为联邦客户端的公开医学问答数据集上评估 FEDVP，使用参数规模从 3B 到 14B 的 Qwen 和 LLaMA 主干。FEDVP 在全部五个客户端上均持续提升性能，平均准确率比最强的传统联邦基线高出 1.46–5.79 个百分点。

title: TransGHOST: Real-Time, Synthesis-Free Reconstruction of Instrument-Occluded Regions in Ophthalmic Microsurgery
zh_title: TransGHOST：眼科显微手术中器械遮挡区域的实时免合成重建
summary: 预印本提出因果、参考引导的重建流程，用已记录帧的几何重采样恢复器械遮挡的组织区域，提供逐像素置信度与来源，并在新的兽医临床数据上评估。
key_points: 非生成式安全模式可实时运行
基于仅可见区域拟合的几何变换重采样
提供逐像素置信度，不支持像素标记为弃权
reason: 眼科手术视频新方法，思路清晰，但为预印本且数据为兽医临床，属值得一看档
abstract: Intraoperative scene perception in ophthalmic microsurgery is limited by instrument occlusion: when a tool enters the high-magnification field, it conceals tissue from both the surgeon and the perception components of robot-assisted systems that process the video. Generative inpainting can remove the occluder but replaces the missing image content with synthesis, which is unsuitable when visual provenance matters. Many video inpainters also depend on future frames and cannot operate online. We present TransGHOST, a causal reference-guided reconstruction pipeline whose non-generative safe mode operates in real time. Every restored value is obtained by resampling a recorded frame using geometric transforms fitted only to visible regions. The system provides per-pixel confidence and provenance and marks unsupported pixels as abstentions. We evaluate TransGHOST on a new veterinary clinical corpus of canine cataract surgery with pixel-level instrument and anatomy labels. Only the occluded region is scored, and each scoring target is verified to differ from the reference supplied to the system. Safe mode reaches 31.89 dB masked PSNR and 0.915 masked SSIM at 51.7 ms median and 85.5 ms 95th-percentile latency. On a pre-declared held-out cohort using instrument cutouts excluded from segmentation training, it reaches 29.83 dB masked PSNR, while matched-mask evaluation on validation shows a 3.45 dB advantage over LaMa. Region-aware reference selection improves masked PSNR by 3.60 dB over recency when candidate references can themselves be occluded. Reference-age analysis further defines the operating interval for the brief, repeated occlusions targeted by TransGHOST.
zh_abstract: 眼科显微手术中的术中场景感知受器械遮挡所限：当器械进入高倍放大视野时，会同时遮住术者以及处理视频的机器人辅助系统感知组件所需观察的组织。生成式图像修复可以去除遮挡物，但会用合成内容替代缺失的图像内容，在视觉来源可追溯性很重要时并不适用。许多视频修复方法还依赖未来帧，无法在线运行。我们提出 TransGHOST，一种因果的、参考引导的重建流程，其非生成式安全模式可实时运行。每一个被恢复的像素值均通过对已记录帧进行重采样获得，所用几何变换仅基于可见区域拟合。该系统提供逐像素的置信度和来源信息，并将缺乏支持的像素标记为弃权。我们在一个新的犬白内障手术兽医临床语料库上评估 TransGHOST，该语料库带有像素级器械和解剖结构标注。仅对被遮挡区域评分，并验证每个评分目标均与提供给系统的参考不同。安全模式的遮罩区域 PSNR 达 31.89 dB，遮罩区域 SSIM 达 0.915，中位延迟为 51.7 ms，第 95 百分位延迟为 85.5 ms。在预先声明的留出队列上（使用未纳入分割训练的器械抠图），其遮罩区域 PSNR 为 29.83 dB；而在验证集上进行的匹配遮罩评估显示其比 LaMa 高 3.45 dB。当候选参考帧本身可能被遮挡时，区域感知的参考选择比按时间最近选择使遮罩区域 PSNR 提高 3.60 dB。参考帧年龄分析进一步界定了 TransGHOST 所针对的短暂、反复遮挡的工作区间。

title: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
zh_title: MEOW：医学开放世界交互式分割
summary: 提出MEOW框架，无需更新参数即可将非交互分割骨干转为交互式开放世界学习器，并在未见类别上持续改进。
key_points: 参数无关的转导推理结合记忆巩固
对训练中未见类别预测持续改进
可零样本迁移至micro-CT等其他模态
reason: 新颖方法的预印本，有零样本迁移但证据有限
abstract: In open-world recognition, machine learning models not only make predictions on unknown structures ("generalized open-set"), but also continually learn and improve from those predictions over time. Interactive segmentation, despite its access to user feedback, has so far remained confined to the open-set setting. In this work we introduce MEOW, the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating learnable model parameters. MEOW combines parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to accumulate knowledge and thereby improve future performance. Focusing on medical data, we show that MEOW consistently improves its own predictions on classes never seen during training, and transfers zero-shot to unfamiliar domains, including micro-CT data and other imaging modalities.

title: Leveraging state-of-the-art AI structure predictors to generate atomic resolution ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins
zh_title: 利用多种 AI 结构预测器生成无序蛋白原子级构象系综
summary: bAIes 框架扩展至 AlphaFold2/3、Boltz-1/2、ESMFold 等六种预测器，系统比较其距离分布，并生成 IDP 原子分辨率构象系综，预印本。
key_points: 比较六种结构预测工具的残基间距离分布
bAIes 生成的系综精度与实验数据相当
是对既有框架的扩展
reason: 有基线对比的方法扩展，但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are central to many biological processes, but their function depends on dynamic conformational ensembles rather than a single structure. Despite the impact of artificial intelligence on protein structure prediction, determining these ensembles at atomistic resolution remains challenging. Recently, we introduced bAIes, a framework that leverages the structural information encoded in AlphaFold2 distograms to generate conformational ensembles of IDPs at atomistic resolution. Here, we extend this framework to six state-of-the-art structure prediction tools (AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, Boltz-1, Boltz-2, ESMFold, and ESMFold2) and systematically compare the structural information encoded in their predicted inter-residue distance distributions. Despite differences between predictors, we show that bAIes generates ensembles with comparable accuracy against experimental NMR and SAXS data, and competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art all-atom simulations and alternative IDP ensemble generation methods. These results demonstrate that bAIes is robust to the choice of structure predictor and that the distance distributions generated by different deep learning architectures contain valuable information about the conformational preferences of disordered proteins. More broadly, our work highlights the potential of combining AI-derived structural information with physics-based modeling to generate atomistic ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins and regions.

title: Pocket similarity guided selection of protein targets for systematic protein ligand dataset generation
zh_title: 基于口袋相似性选择蛋白靶点以系统生成配体数据集
summary: 利用PocketVec描述符绘制人类球状蛋白口袋组，识别15,559个蛋白中51,535个预测可成药口袋，用于为Target 2035选择多样化靶点。
key_points: PocketVec为无需比对的结合位点描述符
覆盖15,559个蛋白、51,535个预测可成药口袋
以口袋相似性而非序列或折叠选靶，最大化多样性
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，服务开放数据计划，但证据有限
abstract: The scarcity of large, diverse, and unbiased protein ligand binding datasets limits the performance of machine learning approaches in drug discovery, particularly for understudied proteins. The Target 2035 initiative aims to address this gap by generating open-access binding data for more than 2,000 human proteins, a goal whose value depends on maximizing the diversity of the selected targets. Because proteins with different folds can share chemically analogous binding sites, we reasoned that pocket similarity, rather than sequence or fold similarity, is the appropriate criterion for selecting representative targets that maximize coverage of the human pocketome. Here, we use PocketVec, an alignment-free descriptor of binding sites, to map the human globular pocketome, identifying 51,535 predicted druggable pockets across 15,559 proteins. A two level hierarchical clustering, first within protein families and then across the whole proteome, grouped these pockets into 1,865 clusters of chemically similar binding sites. After discarding 533 clusters containing pockets with known ligands, we selected the 100 most populated of the remaining 1,332 ligand free clusters and chose two high quality representative pockets per cluster, ranked by their resemblance to known ligand-binding sites. Finally, we implemented two complementary prioritization strategies, one favoring structurally unexplored proteins and the other proteins amenable to experimental follow up, and selected 200 pockets from 100 different clusters from each strategy, with 89 clusters in common. Both selections cover over 10,000 pockets in ~5,600 proteins, approximately 36% of the human proteins with annotated druggable pockets, which represents a 2.8- to 4.4-fold increase in the number of covered pockets, domains, and proteins than random selection baselines. This pocket based framework offers a principled strategy to select diverse targets for Target 2035 and other large scale protein ligand data generation efforts in chemical biology.
zh_abstract: 大型、多样且无偏的蛋白质-配体结合数据集的匮乏限制了机器学习方法在药物发现中的性能，尤其是对于研究不足的蛋白质。Target 2035 计划旨在填补这一空白，为2,000多种人类蛋白质生成开放获取的结合数据，其价值取决于所选靶点多样性的最大化。由于具有不同折叠的蛋白质可能共享化学上相似的结合位点，我们认为，用于选择能够最大化覆盖人类口袋组（pocketome）的代表性靶点的合适标准是口袋相似性，而非序列或折叠相似性。在此，我们使用 PocketVec（一种免比对的结合位点描述符）绘制人类球状蛋白口袋组图谱，在15,559个蛋白质中识别出51,535个预测的可成药口袋。通过两级层次聚类（先在蛋白质家族内，再在整个蛋白质组范围内），这些口袋被分为1,865个化学相似结合位点的簇。在剔除533个含有已知配体口袋的簇后，我们从其余1,332个无配体簇中选取了口袋数最多的100个，并为每个簇选出两个高质量的代表性口袋，按其与已知配体结合位点的相似程度排序。最后，我们实施了两种互补的优先排序策略，一种偏向结构上未被探索的蛋白质，另一种偏向适于后续实验的蛋白质，每种策略均从100个不同的簇中选出200个口袋，两者有89个簇相同。两种选择均覆盖约5,600个蛋白质中的10,000多个口袋，约占具有已注释可成药口袋的人类蛋白质的36%，与随机选择基线相比，所覆盖的口袋、结构域和蛋白质数量增加了2.8至4.4倍。这一基于口袋的框架为 Target 2035 及其他化学生物学领域的大规模蛋白质-配体数据生成工作提供了选择多样化靶点的原则性策略。

title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
zh_title: 审计生物医学研究智能体的决策溯源

key_points: 在 SciFact 八个批次上测试 Qwen3.5-4B 与 Gemma 3 4B

abstract: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site. It restores or transplants those values at their original coordinates, then runs the agent on healthy hardware. Across eight SciFact batches, Qwen3.5-4B shows repeatable citation changes in three capture-claim combinations, and Gemma 3 4B IT shows repeatable read and citation changes in four. These seven combinations cover two claims. Full restoration recovers the reference evidence sets while verdicts remain unchanged. Verdict changes observed under the baseline prompt did not recur under the explicit-example prompt. Complementary tool and optimizer experiments distinguish recovery of numerical state, recovery of ranked lists, and restoration of an agent's visible history. These results show that an audit should track both the evidence an agent uses and its final answer. In hERG cardiac-safety assay allocation, silent numerical faults changed testing decisions while the fixed-budget shortlist kept the same number of compounds labeled as blockers. After the agent had used faulty values, restoring its earlier execution state and supplying certified scores recovered all 39 changed decisions, whereas replacing the prediction file recovered none; no incorrect action was committed. A streaming implementation of the arithmetic checks reduced the total time for forward execution and verification by 42.4% relative to the original FP64 implementation, with identical flags and recovery outputs.

title: Machine Learning Applications in Prostate Cancer Genomics: From Mutation Signatures to Clinical Prediction Models.
source: PubMed · Research and reports in urology

abstract: [Research and reports in urology] Prostate cancer (PCa) is a highly heterogeneous disease with variable clinical outcomes. Advances in next-generation sequencing have enabled comprehensive genomic profiling, generating large-scale datasets that require sophisticated analytical tools. Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful approach for extracting clinically relevant insights from these datasets. This narrative review examines current ML applications in PCa genomics, focusing on mutation signature analysis, biomarker discovery, and clinical prediction models. We also discuss the integration of genomic and clinical data, the limitations of current approaches, and how ML-driven methods can be translated into clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [泌尿外科研究与报告] 前列腺癌（PCa）是一种高度异质性疾病，临床结局各异。二代测序的进步使得全面的基因组分析成为可能，产生了需要复杂分析工具的大规模数据集。机器学习（ML）已成为从这些数据集中提取临床相关见解的有力方法。本叙述性综述探讨了 ML 在 PCa 基因组学中的当前应用，重点关注突变特征分析、生物标志物发现和临床预测模型。我们还讨论了基因组数据与临床数据的整合、现有方法的局限性，以及如何将 ML 驱动的方法转化为临床实践。

title: The evolving landscape of artificial intelligence in cholecystectomy: a bibliometric and science-mapping analysis.
zh_title: 胆囊切除术中AI研究的文献计量与科学图谱分析
summary: 基于559篇文献，分析AI在胆囊切除术研究中的发表趋势、合作网络和主题演变。
key_points: 中国发文最多，美国总被引最高

abstract: [Updates in surgery] To map the global research landscape and thematic evolution of artificial intelligence (AI)-related research in cholecystectomy and to identify major contributors, collaboration patterns, and intellectual foundations. English-language articles and reviews were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus. After deduplication and eligibility screening, 559 publications were included. Publication trends, scientific collaboration, keyword co-occurrence, conceptual structure, thematic evolution, and co-citation and citation-burst patterns were analyzed using bibliometrix, VOSviewer, and Python. Research activity increased markedly in recent years, with 424 publications (75.8%) appearing between 2022 and 2025. China contributed the largest publication output, whereas the United States received the highest total citations. Keyword and conceptual-structure analyses identified research domains involving AI and computational methods, surgical workflow and intraoperative visual analysis, and computer-vision-based applications. Thematic evolution suggested a progression from early workflow- and convolutional-neural-network-related research toward machine learning, deep learning, radiomics, surgical phase recognition, and more recent transformer-related approaches. Twinanda et al. [1] showed the strongest citation burst and occupied a prominent position in the reference co-citation network. AI-related research in cholecystectomy has expanded rapidly and become increasingly diverse in its methodological and application-oriented focus. Current bibliometric patterns suggest growing attention to workflow analysis, computer vision, surgical phase recognition, and newer model architectures. Further multicenter validation and prospective clinical evaluation are needed to determine whether these developments translate into generalizable and clinically meaningful applications.
zh_abstract: [外科学进展] 旨在描绘人工智能（AI）相关胆囊切除术研究的全球研究格局和主题演变，并识别主要贡献者、合作模式和知识基础。从 Web of Science 核心合集和 Scopus 检索英文文章和综述。经去重和资格筛选后，共纳入 559 篇出版物。使用 bibliometrix、VOSviewer 和 Python 分析了发表趋势、科研合作、关键词共现、概念结构、主题演变以及共被引和引文突现模式。近年来研究活动明显增加，424 篇（75.8%）发表于 2022 年至 2025 年之间。中国的发文量最大，而美国的总被引次数最高。关键词和概念结构分析确定了涉及 AI 与计算方法、手术工作流程与术中视觉分析以及基于计算机视觉的应用等研究领域。主题演变提示，研究由早期与工作流程和卷积神经网络相关的研究，逐步发展到机器学习、深度学习、影像组学、手术阶段识别，以及近期与 Transformer 相关的方法。Twinanda 等 [1] 显示出最强的引文突现，并在参考文献共被引网络中占据突出位置。胆囊切除术中与 AI 相关的研究已迅速扩展，其方法学和应用导向的重点日益多样化。目前的文献计量模式提示，工作流程分析、计算机视觉、手术阶段识别和较新的模型架构日益受到关注。仍需进一步开展多中心验证和前瞻性临床评估，以确定这些进展能否转化为可推广且具有临床意义的应用。

title: Deep Learning-Enhanced Lateral-Flow Microarray Biosensor for Multiplexed Inflammatory Biomarker Analysis.
zh_title: 深度学习增强的侧向流微阵列生物传感器用于多重炎症标志物检测
summary: 研究提出基于表面增强拉曼散射的侧向流微阵列芯片LF-SERS-MAC，结合AI辅助分析，在单张纸基器件上检测三种炎症蛋白。

单一纸基器件同时检测三种炎症蛋白

abstract: [Analytical chemistry] Beyond simply functional integration, achieving synergistic enhancements in multiplex detection, quantitative robustness, and intelligent analysis remains a key challenge for next-generation biosensing platforms in precision diagnostics. Lateral flow biosensors are attractive paper-based platforms because of their simplicity, low cost, and rapid operation; however, conventional line-type formats and visual readouts may limit their multiplex quantitative capability. Here, we present a surface-enhanced Raman scattering-based lateral flow microarray chip (LF-SERS-MAC) platform that integrates spatially encoded microarray patterns with AI-assisted analysis to enable sensitive, specific, and stable detection of three inflammatory proteins on a single paper device. The platform employs AuNPDTNB@antibody nanoprobes that simultaneously provide strong Raman signals and specific recognition of target proteins. The 4 × 4 microarray architecture enables spatially separated detection channels and predefined replicate microdots, supporting standardized SERS sampling and replicate-based signal averaging. More importantly, a 2D transformation-based deep learning model was developed for inflammation classification and concentration prediction, which demonstrates higher accuracy than conventional AI models. This platform can be further scaled to high-throughput paper chips, facilitating its clinical translation as a next-generation multiplexed intelligent biosensing strategy.
