abstract: [American journal of health promotion : AJHP] The number of papers published in health promotion journals has grown substantially for two decades, and mainstream use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has accelerated that growth. Yet peer review remains fundamentally unchanged. Review still depends on volunteer time, and many journals prohibit reviewers from using AI to protect confidential, unpublished work. The result is an asymmetry: authors write faster with AI, while reviewers face mounting demand without the same tools. Funding agencies have begun responding; the NIH, for example, now caps annual application submissions per principal investigator. Journals cannot impose comparable limits because submissions are scattered across thousands of independent outlets, and requiring authors to complete reviews in proportion to their publications would be nearly impossible to enforce. We propose a solution that concentrates limited reviewer capacity on the most complex and consequential research. Cross-sectional and other descriptive studies would be evaluated by a purpose-built AI reviewer, trained to assess methodological rigor in such studies and designed not to retain or learn from unpublished manuscripts. Accepted papers would appear in a companion journal or section of the parent title. Traditional peer review would then be reserved for longitudinal, experimental, and other higher-impact research. Beyond easing reviewer burden, this model creates a transparent signal of rigor that could help tenure and promotion committees reward quality over publication quantity.
zh_abstract: [American journal of health promotion : AJHP] 二十年来，健康促进期刊发表的论文数量大幅增长，而生成式人工智能（AI）的主流化使这一增长进一步加速。然而，同行评审在根本上并无改变。评审仍依赖志愿者的时间，许多期刊为保护保密的未发表工作而禁止评审人使用 AI。结果造成不对称：作者借助 AI 写作更快，而评审人面对不断增加的需求却没有同样的工具。资助机构已开始应对；例如，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）现已限制每位主要研究者每年提交的申请数量。期刊无法实施类似限制，因为投稿分散在成千上万家独立出版机构，而要求作者按其发表论文的比例完成评审几乎无法执行。我们提出一种解决方案，将有限的评审能力集中于最复杂、最重要的研究。横断面研究及其他描述性研究将由专门构建的 AI 评审员评估，该评审员经训练可评估此类研究的方法学严谨性，并被设计为不保留未发表稿件也不从中学习。被接受的论文将刊登于母刊的姊妹期刊或专栏。传统同行评审则保留给纵向研究、实验性研究及其他更高影响力的研究。除减轻评审负担外，该模式还创造了一种透明的严谨性信号，可帮助终身教职和晋升委员会奖励质量而非发表数量。

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] The purpose of this study is to develop an explainable deep learning framework for region-wise, multi-label assessment of inner- and middle-ear status on temporal-bone computed tomography (CT). The framework used a ResNet-18 encoder with class-specific attention pooling to predict eight labels representing normal and congenital malformation states of the left and right inner and middle ears. Sparse polygon annotations supervised attention using masked binary cross-entropy, Dice-overlap, and outside-mask penalties. A left-right equivariant consistency regularizer enforced bilateral symmetry under horizontal flipping. The dataset comprised 2399 axial and coronal CT images from 87 patients. Development used fourfold patient-level cross-validation on 35 patients (1018 images), followed by evaluation on a held-out internal test set of 52 patients (1381 images). In cross-validation, the full model achieved a macro-AUC of 0.765 and a macro-F1 of 0.627. On the held-out internal test set, image-level evaluation yielded a macro-AUC of 0.688 and a macro-F1 of 0.572, representing the highest mean performance among the evaluated CNN, vision transformer, and MedViT baselines. Patient-level aggregation further yielded a macro-AUC of 0.716 and a macro-F1 of 0.621. The proposed attention maps were also more side-specific and anatomically concentrated than baseline heatmaps. Attention supervision and bilateral equivariance may improve interpretable temporal-bone CT assessment. Larger external studies and patient-level evaluation are required before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 本研究旨在开发一种可解释的深度学习框架，用于在颞骨计算机断层扫描（CT）上对内耳和中耳状态进行分区域、多标签评估。该框架采用带有类别特异性注意力池化的 ResNet-18 编码器，预测代表左右内耳和中耳正常及先天性畸形状态的八个标签。稀疏的多边形标注通过掩码二元交叉熵、Dice 重叠以及掩码外惩罚项来监督注意力。左右等变一致性正则化项在水平翻转下强制保持双侧对称性。数据集包含来自 87 名患者的 2399 幅轴位和冠状位 CT 图像。模型开发在 35 名患者（1018 幅图像）上采用四折患者水平交叉验证，随后在 52 名患者（1381 幅图像）的保留内部测试集上进行评估。在交叉验证中，完整模型的宏平均 AUC 为 0.765，宏平均 F1 为 0.627。在保留的内部测试集上，图像水平评估的宏平均 AUC 为 0.688，宏平均 F1 为 0.572，在所评估的 CNN、视觉 Transformer 和 MedViT 基线中平均性能最高。患者水平聚合进一步得到宏平均 AUC 0.716 和宏平均 F1 0.621。所提出的注意力图也比基线热图更具侧别特异性，并更集中于解剖结构。注意力监督和双侧等变性可能改善可解释的颞骨 CT 评估。在临床部署之前，仍需要更大规模的外部研究和患者水平评估。

abstract: [Health science reports] The integration of medical artificial intelligence (AI) in rural India holds transformative potential for enhancing healthcare access and quality. This narrative review examines the promising applications of medical AI in addressing healthcare disparities, increasing service efficiency, and mitigating physician shortages in underserved areas. However, challenges persist, including medical students' limited awareness and education about AI, reluctance to engage in rural health services, and migration trends affecting healthcare delivery. Effective implementation demands a multifaceted approach, tackling technological, economic, and contextual obstacles through stakeholder collaboration. Ethical considerations such as bias, data privacy, and local workforce involvement are paramount for the responsible deployment of medical AI. This review delves into both the opportunities and challenges, emphasizing the importance of addressing these issues through enhanced education and ethical frameworks. Ultimately, a balanced strategy is essential to harness the potential of medical AI in revolutionizing rural healthcare, highlighting the need for innovative policies that align technological advancements with community needs.

abstract: [Dermatology and therapy] Artificial intelligence (AI) is playing an expanding role in dermatology, particularly in diagnosing skin cancer and other cutaneous diseases. However, little is known about public perceptions towards AI for skincare evaluation and management. The purpose of this study was to assess public trust, comfort, and security concerns about AI-based facial evaluation. A cross-sectional survey was administered to 147 participants through Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) and REDCap. Participants rated comfort, trust, and security concerns regarding AI and dermatologist evaluation of facial images using a 5-point Likert scale. Wilcoxon Signed-Rank tests were used to compare preference for AI vs. dermatologists. Participants expressed greater confidence in dermatologists than AI for independent evaluation of facial features (mean 4.37 vs. 3.82, P < 0.001) and trust in creating a skincare management plan (mean 4.46 vs. 3.87, P < 0.001). Privacy and security concerns were prevalent, with 69% agreeing they were worried about security risks of AI facial imaging. Participants had confidence in AI technology for skincare evaluation and management, although they tended to prefer dermatologists over AI. Security was a concern for AI facial imaging.
zh_abstract: [皮肤病学与治疗] 人工智能（AI）在皮肤病学中的作用日益扩大，尤其是在诊断皮肤癌和其他皮肤疾病方面。然而，公众对用于皮肤护理评估和管理的 AI 的看法所知甚少。本研究旨在评估公众对基于 AI 的面部评估的信任、舒适度和安全顾虑。通过 Amazon Mechanical Turk（MTurk）和 REDCap 对 147 名参与者进行了横断面调查。参与者使用 5 点 Likert 量表，对 AI 和皮肤科医生评估面部图像的舒适度、信任度和安全顾虑进行评分。采用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验比较对 AI 与皮肤科医生的偏好。在独立评估面部特征方面，参与者对皮肤科医生的信心高于 AI（均值 4.37 vs. 3.82，P < 0.001）；在制定皮肤护理管理方案方面，对皮肤科医生的信任也高于 AI（均值 4.46 vs. 3.87，P < 0.001）。隐私和安全顾虑普遍存在，69% 的参与者同意其担心 AI 面部成像的安全风险。参与者对用于皮肤护理评估和管理的 AI 技术有信心，但倾向于更偏好皮肤科医生而非 AI。安全性是 AI 面部成像方面的一个顾虑。

abstract: [American journal of psychoanalysis] This paper critically examines the use of therapeutic chatbots based on artificial intelligence from a psychoanalytic perspective. Drawing on current literature, it questions the legitimacy of labeling these tools as "therapeutic," arguing that they lack essential elements such as subjectivity, transference, symbolization, and the capacity for psychic transformation. A case example illustrates how the relationship users establish with chatbots is narcissistic remaining in the "as if" register in the absence of a real other to enable intersubjectivity. Ethical, epistemological, and clinical implications are discussed, especially in relation to vulnerable populations. The paper highlights the urgency for ethical reflection, regulation, and long-term research as these technologies advance in the field of mental health.

abstract: [Breathe (Sheffield, England)] Automated detection of pulmonary nodules on computed tomography has evolved from rule-based image processing algorithms to sophisticated artificial intelligence (AI) systems capable of nodule localisation, volumetric measurement and malignancy risk stratification. title: CLADE: Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models

summary: 指出检索段落仅给出粗粒度类别时，语言模型倾向直接作答而非弃答或继续检索，并借助本体解决可消解的不足（预印本）。

abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems often retrieve passages that are accurate and relevant but state the answer at a coarser level of granularity than the question requires. For example, a question may ask which specific disease a drug treats (familial hyperlipidemia), while the retrieved passage mentions the broader disease family (hyperlipidemia). Prior work on context sufficiency treats such coarse passages simply as insufficient. We argue that they form a distinct case, which we call resolvable insufficiency: text alone cannot settle the fine-grained answer, but the broader category it mentions maps to a short list of candidate answers in a domain ontology. When language models read these coarse, family-only passages, they exhibit a phenomenon we call Clade (Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence): they answer instead of abstaining or searching further. On biomedical questions from PrimeKG, family-only passages reduce abstention by 13.8 points compared to uninformative passages, and the resulting guesses are wrong about half the time. A counterfactual test confirms the cause: replacing an exact disease name with its broader family name lowers abstention by 17.4 points compared to deleting the sentence. Simple fixes like confidence filtering, scaling to a larger model, and explicitly instructing the model to abstain cannot resolve Clade, and this replicates on ecological species interactions in GloBI. Finally, we test whether an ontology can turn coarse passages into exact answers. Given the correct family, an ontology list includes the true answer in 98.5% of cases, but string matching finds that family on the page for only 19.8%. Letting the model choose the family raises this to 30.0% and end-to-end recovery from 10.0% to 26.8%. Overall, our results show when language models should stop guessing and consult an ontology, and highlight which steps of that process remain unsolved.
zh_abstract: 检索增强系统常常检索到准确且相关的段落，但这些段落陈述答案的粒度比问题所要求的更粗。例如，问题可能询问某种药物治疗的具体疾病（家族性高脂血症），而检索到的段落只提到更广泛的疾病类别（高脂血症）。以往关于上下文充分性的研究将此类粗粒度段落简单地视为不充分。我们认为它们构成一种独特情形，称之为可解析的不充分性（resolvable insufficiency）：仅凭文本无法确定细粒度答案，但其中提到的更宽泛类别可在领域本体中映射到一个简短的候选答案列表。当语言模型阅读这些粗粒度、仅含类别信息的段落时，会表现出一种我们称为 Clade（Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence，基于不足证据的类别层级作答）的现象：它们会直接作答，而不是弃答或进一步检索。在 PrimeKG 的生物医学问题上，与无信息段落相比，仅含类别信息的段落使弃答率降低 13.8 个百分点，且由此产生的猜测约有一半是错误的。一项反事实测试证实了原因：与删除该句子相比，将确切的疾病名称替换为其更宽泛的类别名称会使弃答率降低 17.4 个百分点。置信度过滤、扩大到更大模型以及明确指示模型弃答等简单修正方法均无法解决 Clade，并且这一现象在 GloBI 的生态物种相互作用数据上得到复现。最后，我们检验本体能否将粗粒度段落转化为精确答案。给定正确的类别，本体列表在 98.5% 的情况下包含真实答案，但字符串匹配仅在 19.8% 的情况下能在页面上找到该类别。让模型选择类别可将这一比例提高到 30.0%，并将端到端恢复率从 10.0% 提高到 26.8%。总体而言，我们的结果表明了语言模型应在何时停止猜测并查询本体，并指出该过程中哪些步骤仍未解决。

abstract: Many scientific and policy decisions require estimating the total number of target objects across a large image collection. Exhaustive human labeling is often infeasible, while raw model predictions can be biased, especially under domain shift. Recent human-AI estimation methods combine imperfect model predictions with limited human verification to obtain reliable collection-level estimates. However, existing work provides little guidance on how practitioners should choose among models, estimators, and adaptation strategies for a new deployment. We study these choices within a common human-in-the-loop counting framework across 12 tasks spanning biomedical microscopy, ground-level and aerial wildlife surveys, and overhead imagery of urban structures. Our results show that modern multimodal models provide a strong, training-free starting point for many tasks, while fine-tuned detectors become more advantageous at larger labeling budgets and across repeated deployments. Estimation efficiency improves further when model predictions are used to prioritize which units humans label, rather than sampling uniformly. We also find that each model's ranking quality can be estimated with a small pilot set, yielding practical guidance for selecting strategies on new counting tasks. In a field deployment on aerial pronghorn surveys, a task-specific adaptation of these methods meets the survey's $\pm 5\%$ tolerance after reviewing a median of only $3.2\%$ of collected images.
zh_abstract: 许多科学和政策决策需要估计大型图像集合中目标物体的总数。对其进行全面的人工标注往往不可行，而模型的原始预测可能存在偏差，在领域偏移下尤其如此。近期的人机协同估计方法将不完美的模型预测与有限的人工核验相结合，以获得可靠的集合层面估计。然而，对于从业者在新部署中应如何在模型、估计器和适应策略之间做出选择，现有工作几乎没有提供指导。我们在一个通用的人在回路计数框架下研究这些选择，涵盖 12 项任务，涉及生物医学显微成像、地面与航空野生动物调查以及城市建筑的俯视影像。结果表明，现代多模态模型为许多任务提供了强大的、无需训练的起点，而微调后的检测器在标注预算较大以及重复部署时更具优势。若利用模型预测来决定优先由人工标注哪些单元，而不是均匀采样，估计效率会进一步提高。我们还发现，每个模型的排序质量可以用小规模的试点集来估计，从而为在新的计数任务中选择策略提供实用指导。在一项针对叉角羚航空调查的实地部署中，这些方法经针对任务的调整后，仅需复核所采集图像的中位数 $3.2\%$，即可满足调查 $\pm 5\%$ 的容许误差。

title: Prior-informed machine learning for clinically interpretable medical diagnosis.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology
zh_title: 先验引导机器学习实现可解释临床诊断
summary: 提出PIML框架，通过贝叶斯推断结合临床生成式推理与数据驱动判别模型，给出患者特异的可解释诊断结果。

将敏感度/特异度优化纳入建模

abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] Traditional machine learning (ML) in medical diagnostics often suffers from limited clinical interpretability and poor generalization, owing to its black-box, data-driven nature. Here, we present Prior-Informed Machine Learning (PIML), a framework that integrates clinically grounded generative reasoning with data-driven, ML-enabled discriminative modeling through Bayesian inference to provide clinically interpretable, patient-specific diagnostic outcomes. By embedding the optimization of sensitivity and specificity in data-driven diagnosis-requirements for subsequent Bayesian inference-directly into the ML model development process, PIML enables a synergistic integration of machine learning and clinical expertise that cannot be achieved through either data-driven or clinically grounded approaches alone. PIML was validated across three clinical domains-cervical neoplasia detection, high-risk oral lesion detection, and preterm birth detection-where Bayesian inference was systematically employed to integrate electrical impedance spectroscopy (EIS)-based machine learning with domain-specific clinical expertise, thereby enabling more comprehensive and enhanced diagnostic decision-making. Our results demonstrate that PIML generally improves diagnostic performance compared with standard ML approaches and provides competitive or superior performance relative to knowledge-based and feature-level prior integration strategies. This work presents an innovative, systematic framework with strong potential for widespread adoption in addressing medical diagnostic challenges across heterogeneous clinical environments.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] 传统机器学习（ML）在医学诊断中因其黑箱、数据驱动的特性，常常存在临床可解释性有限和泛化能力差的问题。在此，我们提出先验知识引导的机器学习（Prior-Informed Machine Learning，PIML）框架，该框架通过贝叶斯推断，将基于临床的生成式推理与数据驱动、由 ML 实现的判别式建模相结合，以提供具有临床可解释性、针对患者个体的诊断结果。通过将数据驱动诊断中敏感性和特异性的优化（后续贝叶斯推断的必要条件）直接嵌入 ML 模型开发过程，PIML 实现了机器学习与临床专业知识的协同整合，这是单独采用数据驱动或基于临床的方法所无法实现的。PIML 在三个临床领域得到验证——宫颈肿瘤检测、高危口腔病变检测和早产检测——其中系统性地运用贝叶斯推断，将基于电阻抗谱（EIS）的机器学习与特定领域的临床专业知识相整合，从而实现更全面、更强的诊断决策。我们的结果表明，与标准 ML 方法相比，PIML 总体上提高了诊断性能，并且相对于基于知识和特征层面的先验整合策略，提供了具有竞争力或更优的性能。这项工作提出了一个创新的、系统性的框架，在应对异质临床环境中的医学诊断挑战方面具有被广泛采用的巨大潜力。

title: Identification of metabolic vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal targets utilizing artificial intelligence-driven precision medicine.

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Cancer metabolism is highly plastic, and most attempts to turn that plasticity into a therapeutic target fail for a specific, recurring reason: a computational prediction of a metabolic vulnerability is not the same evidentiary object as an experimentally confirmed one, and the two are routinely discussed as if they were interchangeable. This review takes that distinction as its starting point rather than its conclusion. Artificial intelligence and genome-scale systems biology have made it easy to generate metabolic hypotheses at a scale no experimental program could match - machine learning models trained on genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data now output candidate vulnerabilities, biomarkers, and drug combinations faster than they can be tested - but the resulting literature has not been consistently honest about how far any given prediction has actually traveled toward clinical relevance. We examine six areas where this gap is most visible: multi-omics data integration, genome-scale metabolic network modeling, computational discovery of metabolic vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal interactions, single-cell and spatial resolution of metabolic heterogeneity, AI-guided drug and biomarker discovery, and the small set of studies that have actually reached clinical testing. Rather than summarizing these areas as separate literatures, we grade every substantive finding discussed against an explicit four-tier evidence standard - associative, mechanistic, perturbation-validated, or clinically tested - and we apply that standard critically rather than deferentially: several widely cited computational vulnerabilities remain unconfirmed outside the cell lines in which they were discovered, genome-scale models continue to carry unresolved gaps in reaction coverage that limit their predictive reach, and, of the AI-derived metabolic predictions discussed in this review, only one has so far been tested in a completed prospective clinical trial. We argue that this shortage of prospective validation, not a shortage of computational sophistication, is the field's central constraint, and we close by identifying where methodological effort would do the most good: standardized validation reporting, tissue-resolved rather than bulk metabolic models, and closer coupling between computational prediction and the specific experimental designs capable of falsifying it.
zh_abstract: [肿瘤学前沿] 癌症代谢具有高度可塑性，而大多数试图将这种可塑性转化为治疗靶点的尝试之所以失败，有一个具体且反复出现的原因：对代谢脆弱性的计算预测与经实验证实的脆弱性并不是同一种证据对象，但二者常被当作可互换的对象来讨论。本综述将这一区别作为出发点而非结论。人工智能和基因组规模的系统生物学使得以任何实验项目都无法比拟的规模生成代谢假说变得容易——基于基因组、转录组、蛋白质组和代谢组数据训练的机器学习模型，现在输出候选脆弱性、生物标志物和药物组合的速度快于其被检验的速度——但由此产生的文献并未始终如实说明任何一项预测实际上向临床相关性推进了多远。我们考察了这一差距最为明显的六个领域：多组学数据整合、基因组规模代谢网络建模、代谢脆弱性和合成致死相互作用的计算发现、代谢异质性的单细胞和空间分辨率研究、人工智能引导的药物和生物标志物发现，以及少数真正进入临床测试的研究。我们并非将这些领域作为独立文献分别总结，而是依据明确的四级证据标准——关联性、机制性、扰动验证、临床检验——对所讨论的每一项实质性发现进行分级，并以批判而非顺从的方式应用该标准：若干被广泛引用的计算脆弱性在其发现所用的细胞系之外仍未得到证实，基因组规模模型在反应覆盖方面仍存在未解决的缺口，限制了其预测范围，并且在本综述讨论的人工智能衍生代谢预测中，迄今仅有一项在已完成的前瞻性临床试验中得到检验。我们认为，该领域的核心制约因素是前瞻性验证的不足，而非计算复杂度的不足；最后我们指出了方法学上投入努力最有价值之处：标准化的验证报告、组织分辨而非整体（bulk）的代谢模型，以及计算预测与能够证伪它的具体实验设计之间更紧密的结合。

abstract: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges' average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.
zh_abstract: 紧急情况可能发生在没有手机信号、附近也没有救护车的地方。手机上的小型语言模型在此类情形下可能有所帮助，但其建议必须安全且准确。我们构建了 HandsOnAid，这是一个使用 QLoRA 在 FirstAidQA 数据集（包含 5,550 个急救问答对的语料库）上微调的 4 位 Gemma 2B 模型。我们比较了七种配置，包括基础模型、4 位和 8 位微调模型，以及加入长度下限、安全门控或检索的版本。我们使用了一个包含 41 个问答对的题库，其参考答案经医学审核并遵循 ANZCOR 指南，评分采用严格的 0–5 分量表，并设有十二条安全否决规则。四个前沿大语言模型评判者（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.3）对每个回答进行盲评，并使用 45 个隐藏对照检验评判者的可靠性。微调使平均得分较基础模型提高 +1.08，达到 2.34。得分最高的配置为带检索的 4 位微调模型，得分为 2.51（满分 5 分）。一名医学专业人员还对基础模型、4 位微调模型和检索配置的 40 个回答进行了盲评，其得分与大语言模型评判者的平均得分相近。关键词审查发现，训练语料对评分量表所要求的 ANZCOR 指南若干细节覆盖有限，这提示训练数据中信息缺失可能是得分偏低的原因之一。在智能手机设备（Pixel 7 Pro）上，使用六个 CPU 线程且无网络连接时，4 位微调模型在十个问题上平均 6.86 秒生成首个可显示文本，14.88 秒生成完整回答。

title: RNA Small-Molecule Binding-Site Prediction by Integrating RNA Language Models and Structural Geometry

abstract: RNAs are emerging as promising therapeutic targets, and small-molecule binding can modulate their structure and function, creating opportunities for therapeutic development. Accurate identification of RNA small-molecule binding sites is therefore important for understanding RNA-ligand interactions and facilitating RNA-targeted drug discovery. However, the structural complexity of RNA and the limited availability of experimentally characterized RNA-ligand complexes pose challenges for computational binding-site prediction. In this study, we propose RSMBind, a graph attention-based deep learning framework for nucleotide-level prediction of RNA-small molecule binding sites. The model integrates geometric descriptors of the local three-dimensional environment with pretrained RNA language model embeddings to capture complementary structural and sequence information. We investigate three pretrained RNA language models RNA-BERT, ERNIE-RNA and RNA-FM and assess the contributions of sequence representations and geometric features through feature-level ablation experiments. The model is developed using the TR60 and HARIBOSS datasets and evaluated on four independent benchmark datasets: RB9, TE18, TL12 and JL10. RSMBind achieves the highest MCC among the compared methods on three of the four benchmarks, with relative improvements of 17.1% on RB9, 7.2% on TL12 and 16.0% on JL10 over the best previously reported results, while achieving competitive performance on TE18. Furthermore, RSMBind retains predictive capability when using only pretrained RNA language model embeddings, highlighting their potential utility when explicit tertiary structural features are unavailable. Structural analysis indicates differences in prediction performance across RNA structural regions, with loop-associated binding sites generally being captured more effectively than those embedded within stem regions. Additionally, 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations of selected RNA-ligand complexes provide insights into the relationship between predicted binding probabilities and dynamic ligand proximity, further highlighting the role of conformational dynamics in evaluating structure-based predictions. The source code is available at [ https://github.com/sharma-nandita/RSMBind].
zh_abstract: RNA 正在成为有前景的治疗靶点，小分子结合可以调节其结构和功能，为治疗开发创造了机会。因此，准确识别 RNA–小分子结合位点对于理解 RNA–配体相互作用和促进 RNA 靶向药物发现具有重要意义。然而，RNA 结构的复杂性以及经实验表征的 RNA–配体复合物数量有限，给结合位点的计算预测带来了挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了 RSMBind，一种基于图注意力的深度学习框架，用于核苷酸水平的 RNA–小分子结合位点预测。该模型将局部三维环境的几何描述符与预训练 RNA 语言模型的嵌入相结合，以捕捉互补的结构和序列信息。我们研究了三种预训练 RNA 语言模型 RNA-BERT、ERNIE-RNA 和 RNA-FM，并通过特征层面的消融实验评估序列表征和几何特征的贡献。该模型使用 TR60 和 HARIBOSS 数据集开发，并在四个独立基准数据集 RB9、TE18、TL12 和 JL10 上进行评估。RSMBind 在四个基准中的三个上取得了对比方法中最高的 MCC，相比此前报道的最佳结果，在 RB9、TL12 和 JL10 上分别相对提高了 17.1%、7.2% 和 16.0%，同时在 TE18 上取得了具有竞争力的性能。此外，当仅使用预训练 RNA 语言模型嵌入时，RSMBind 仍保持预测能力，凸显了其在缺乏明确三级结构特征时的潜在用途。结构分析表明，不同 RNA 结构区域的预测性能存在差异，与环相关的结合位点通常比位于茎区的结合位点更容易被有效捕获。此外，对选定 RNA–配体复合物进行的 100 ns 分子动力学模拟，为预测的结合概率与配体动态接近程度之间的关系提供了见解，进一步凸显了构象动力学在评估基于结构的预测中的作用。源代码可在 [https://github.com/sharma-nandita/RSMBind] 获取。

abstract: [ArXiv] To accelerate chemical exchange saturation transfer magnetic resonance fingerprinting (CEST-MRF) using temporal deep learning reconstruction. Ten healthy volunteers underwent repeated test-retest golden-angle radial CEST-MRF acquisitions with 30 measurements and 34 spokes per measurement. The Movienet network was adapted to reconstruct accelerated radial CEST-MRF data. Separate models were trained using 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 20, and 34 spokes per measurement. Temporal and coil correlations were exploited by concatenating time and coil dimensions in the input. GRASP-based locally low-rank (GRASP-LLR) reconstruction was used for comparison. Quantitative DRONE fitting generated tissue parameter maps. Movienet-8 was evaluated with leave-one-subject-out analysis. Prospectively acquired 8-spoke datasets were compared with paired 34-spoke acquisitions, and Movienet-8 and Movienet-34 were compared with a 64-spoke acquisition. In the held-out retrospective series, median Pearson correlations between Movienet and GRASP-LLR were 0.795, 0.947, 0.974, 0.977, and 0.981 for 1, 8, 16, 20, and 34 spokes, respectively. Corresponding NRMSE values were 14.7, 8.2, 5.9, 5.3, and 5.1 percent. Across 10 leave-one-subject-out volunteers, median image correlation was 0.965 and NRMSE was 7.5 percent. Reconstruction of a 30-slice series required 1.7 s with Movienet versus approximately 45 min with GRASP-LLR. Movienet enables whole-brain radial CEST-MRF acquisition in 3 min, with image reconstruction in less than 2 s.

abstract: [Cardiovascular & hematological disorders drug targets] One of the main causes of death in the world is Cardiovascular Diseases (CVDs). The number of acute myocardial infarctions and fatalities may be considerably decreased by early detection of Cardiovascular (CV) events. However, the efficacy of conventional data analysis for diagnosis and treatment is hampered by the complexity of the disease and the wide range of affecting factors. Large, multidimensional medical datasets can be processed by Artificial Intelligence (AI) owing to its sophisticated computational capabilities. This narrative review was conducted through a structured search of PubMed/ MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar to identify peer-reviewed literature on artificial intelligence in cardiovascular medicine. Relevant studies addressing diagnosis, risk stratification, prognostic prediction, cardiovascular imaging, and clinical implementation were critically evaluated with emphasis on methodological quality, external validation, clinical applicability, and implementation challenges. AI-based systems have been shown to be more effective at classifying risk, predicting outcomes, and spotting illness trends. Early diagnosis and more customized treatment plans are made possible by these algorithms' ability to examine intricate relationships in large healthcare datasets. Clinical applications have improved auxiliary diagnostic instruments and increased patient care effectiveness. AI offers more accuracy and flexibility than traditional approaches when handling high-dimensional CVD data. It may reduce the burden of disease and promote tailored treatment regimens. However, data quality, standardization, and ethical concerns for broad use remain issues. The detection and treatment of CVDs are being revolutionized by AI-powered technology. Their use in clinical settings may improve cardiovascular care and lower the number of heart disease-related deaths worldwide.

abstract: The arteriolar-to-venular diameter ratio (AVR) is a clinically motivated marker of retinal vascular health. We present a five-stage pipeline for AVR estimation and exploratory retinopathy screening from fundus images, with inspectable intermediate outputs at each stage. The pipeline combines vessel and artery-vein masks, optic-disc localization, vessel-calibre estimation using a minimal-chord boundary walk, and AVR computation from dominant arterial and venular branches. An explicit threshold-based rule produces the screening decision, enabling errors to be traced to individual processing stages. On an exploratory cohort of 30 HRF images, we report 96.7% accuracy, an F1-score of 0.968 and ROC-AUC of 0.978. Ablation studies and an exploratory comparison with VascX examine the effects of vessel pairing, calibre measurement and aggregation. Interpretation is limited by the small cohort, proxy disease labels and absence of independent reference calibre measurements. The pipeline provides a transparent framework for investigating retinal vascular biomarkers, with further validation needed on larger, clinically graded cohorts.

abstract: [Frontiers in psychology] This article presents a six-step ethical decision-making model for mental health professionals confronted with ethical concerns arising when clients use large language models (LLMs) for mental health support. LLMs may introduce ethical problems that existing decision-making models were not designed to address. To provide guidance, we synthesized two bodies of research, the first concerning ethical risks posed by LLM use, and the second about existing decision-making models, to create a new model designed specifically for LLM and AI-related ethical issues. Our model addresses AI-specific phenomena such as deceptive empathy, algorithmic bias, digital attachment, and diffuse accountability structures. We propose this model as a conceptual foundation and encourage its ongoing refinement as AI continues to evolve.
